en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie contemporaine de l'esprit débat si la conscience est mieux expliquée par la théorie de l'espace de travail global la théorie de l'information intégrée les théories d'ordre supérieur les cadres de traitement prédictif ou si la conscience reste fondamentalement résistante à l'explication scientifique en troisième personne.
hint: He maintained that the contemporary philosophy of mind debates whether consciousness is best explained by global workspace theory integrated information theory higher-order theories predictive processing frameworks or whether consciousness remains fundamentally resistant to third-person scientific explanation.
answers: He maintained that the contemporary philosophy of mind debates whether consciousness is best explained by global workspace theory integrated information theory higher-order theories predictive processing frameworks or whether consciousness remains fundamentally resistant to third-person scientific explanation.

en: Elle a soutenu que la théorie de l'espace de travail global de la conscience, développée par Baars et plus tard Dehaene, soutient que la conscience consiste en la diffusion globale de l'information depuis un espace de travail central vers de nombreux systèmes spécialisés et que cette disponibilité globale distingue le traitement conscient du traitement inconscient.
hint: She argued that the global workspace theory of consciousness, developed by Baars and later Dehaene, holds that consciousness consists in the global broadcasting of information from a central workspace to many specialised systems and that this global availability is what distinguishes conscious from unconscious processing.
answers: She argued that the global workspace theory of consciousness, developed by Baars and later Dehaene, holds that consciousness consists in the global broadcasting of information from a central workspace to many specialised systems and that this global availability is what distinguishes conscious from unconscious processing.

en: Il a soutenu que la théorie de l'information intégrée développée par Tononi soutient que la conscience est identique à l'information intégrée mesurée par phi et que tout système avec un phi suffisamment élevé a de l'expérience consciente avec des implications pour la conscience animale et machinale.
hint: He contended that integrated information theory developed by Tononi holds that consciousness is identical to integrated information measured by phi and that any system with sufficiently high phi has conscious experience with implications for animal and machine consciousness.
answers: He contended that integrated information theory developed by Tononi holds that consciousness is identical to integrated information measured by phi and that any system with sufficiently high phi has conscious experience with implications for animal and machine consciousness.

en: Elle a soutenu que le cadre de traitement prédictif, associé à Clark, Friston et d'autres, soutient que le cerveau est fondamentalement une machine prédictive qui génère continuellement des prédictions sur les entrées sensorielles et met à jour ses modèles sur la base de signaux d'erreur de prédiction provenant des sens.
hint: She maintained that the predictive processing framework, associated with Clark Friston and others, holds that the brain is fundamentally a prediction machine that continuously generates predictions about sensory input and updates its models based on prediction error signals from the senses.
answers: She maintained that the predictive processing framework, associated with Clark Friston and others, holds that the brain is fundamentally a prediction machine that continuously generates predictions about sensory input and updates its models based on prediction error signals from the senses.

en: Il a soutenu que le principe d'énergie libre de Friston, unifiant le traitement prédictif et l'inférence active, soutient que les systèmes biologiques s'auto-organisent pour minimiser la surprise ou l'énergie libre et que cela fournit un cadre unificateur pour comprendre la perception l'action l'apprentissage et la conscience dans les systèmes biologiques.
hint: He argued that the free energy principle of Friston, unifying predictive processing and active inference, holds that biological systems self-organise to minimise surprise or free energy and that this provides a unifying framework for understanding perception action learning and consciousness in biological systems.
answers: He argued that the free energy principle of Friston, unifying predictive processing and active inference, holds that biological systems self-organise to minimise surprise or free energy and that this provides a unifying framework for understanding perception action learning and consciousness in biological systems.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie du soi examine s'il existe un soi unifié et persistant dans le temps ou si le soi est une construction narrative une illusion générée par les processus cognitifs ou une collection de processus corporels mentaux et sociaux sans noyau central.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of the self examines whether there is a unified persistent self across time or whether the self is a narrative construction an illusion generated by cognitive processes or a collection of bodily mental and social processes without a central core.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of the self examines whether there is a unified persistent self across time or whether the self is a narrative construction an illusion generated by cognitive processes or a collection of bodily mental and social processes without a central core.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de soi narratif en philosophie contemporaine, développé par Ricoeur, MacIntyre et Taylor, soutient que l'identité personnelle et l'unité d'une vie sont constituées par l'interprétation narrative de sa propre expérience et que nous sommes les histoires que nous racontons sur nous-mêmes.
hint: He maintained that the concept of narrative self in contemporary philosophy, developed by Ricoeur MacIntyre and Taylor, holds that personal identity and the unity of a life is constituted through the narrative interpretation of one's own experience and that we are the stories we tell about ourselves.
answers: He maintained that the concept of narrative self in contemporary philosophy, developed by Ricoeur MacIntyre and Taylor, holds that personal identity and the unity of a life is constituted through the narrative interpretation of one's own experience and that we are the stories we tell about ourselves.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de psychologie morale examine les fondements psychologiques des jugements moraux notamment le rôle de l'émotion de la raison de l'intuition et des normes sociales dans la génération de réponses morales avec des implications pour la compréhension de la responsabilité morale du libre arbitre et les cibles appropriées de l'éducation morale.
hint: She argued that the concept of moral psychology examines the psychological foundations of moral judgments including the role of emotion reason intuition and social norms in generating moral responses with implications for how we understand moral responsibility free will and the appropriate targets of moral education.
answers: She argued that the concept of moral psychology examines the psychological foundations of moral judgments including the role of emotion reason intuition and social norms in generating moral responses with implications for how we understand moral responsibility free will and the appropriate targets of moral education.

en: Il a soutenu que le modèle social intuitionniste de psychologie morale de Jonathan Haidt soutient que le jugement moral est principalement conduit par l'intuition et l'émotion avec le raisonnement post-hoc servant principalement à justifier des conclusions déjà atteintes plutôt qu'à être le principal moteur de la prise de décision morale.
hint: He contended that Jonathan Haidt's social intuitionist model of moral psychology holds that moral judgment is primarily driven by intuition and emotion with post-hoc reasoning serving mainly to justify conclusions already reached rather than being the primary driver of moral decision-making.
answers: He contended that Jonathan Haidt's social intuitionist model of moral psychology holds that moral judgment is primarily driven by intuition and emotion with post-hoc reasoning serving mainly to justify conclusions already reached rather than being the primary driver of moral decision-making.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de trolleyologie l'étude systématique des variations du problème du tramway a généré un large corpus de données sur les intuitions morales révélant que les humains appliquent différents principes moraux dans différents scénarios soulevant des questions sur la question de savoir si cela révèle de véritables principes moraux ou des intuitions incohérentes.
hint: She maintained that the concept of trolleyology the systematic study of trolley problem variations has generated a large body of data about moral intuitions revealing that humans apply different moral principles in different scenarios raising questions about whether this reveals genuine moral principles or inconsistent intuitions.
answers: She maintained that the concept of trolleyology the systematic study of trolley problem variations has generated a large body of data about moral intuitions revealing that humans apply different moral principles in different scenarios raising questions about whether this reveals genuine moral principles or inconsistent intuitions.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'ahurissement moral, documenté par Haidt, décrit le phénomène où les personnes maintiennent des jugements moraux qu'elles ne peuvent pas justifier après que leurs justifications initiales ont été réfutées suggérant que le jugement moral n'est pas fondamentalement rationnel mais conduit émotionnellement.
hint: He argued that the concept of moral dumbfounding, documented by Haidt, describes the phenomenon where people maintain moral judgments they cannot justify after their initial justifications are refuted suggesting that moral judgment is not fundamentally rational but emotionally driven.
answers: He argued that the concept of moral dumbfounding, documented by Haidt, describes the phenomenon where people maintain moral judgments they cannot justify after their initial justifications are refuted suggesting that moral judgment is not fundamentally rational but emotionally driven.

en: Elle a soutenu que l'étude empirique de la diversité morale à travers les cultures et l'histoire a des implications pour l'épistémologie morale soulevant la question de la façon dont nous pouvons avoir une connaissance morale si les croyances morales varient si largement et si la convergence morale cross-culturelle sur certaines questions fournit des preuves de vérités morales objectives.
hint: She contended that the empirical study of moral diversity across cultures and history has implications for moral epistemology raising the question of how we can have moral knowledge if moral beliefs vary so widely and whether cross-cultural moral convergence on some issues provides evidence for objective moral truths.
answers: She contended that the empirical study of moral diversity across cultures and history has implications for moral epistemology raising the question of how we can have moral knowledge if moral beliefs vary so widely and whether cross-cultural moral convergence on some issues provides evidence for objective moral truths.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'éthique des vertus dans son renouveau contemporain associé à Foot, Geach, MacIntyre, Hursthouse et Williams remet en question la déontologie kantienne et le conséquentialisme utilitariste en retournant la théorie morale à la primauté du caractère de la vertu et de l'épanouissement humain.
hint: He maintained that the concept of virtue ethics in its contemporary revival associated with Foot Geach MacIntyre Hursthouse and Williams challenges both Kantian deontology and utilitarian consequentialism by returning moral theory to the primacy of character virtue and human flourishing.
answers: He maintained that the concept of virtue ethics in its contemporary revival associated with Foot Geach MacIntyre Hursthouse and Williams challenges both Kantian deontology and utilitarian consequentialism by returning moral theory to the primacy of character virtue and human flourishing.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'éthique des vertus néo-aristotélicienne soulève la question de l'unité des vertus si les vertus forment un tout interconnecté ou peuvent exister isolément, Aristote soutenant l'unité des vertus à travers le rôle central de la sagesse pratique comme coordinateur des vertus.
hint: She argued that the concept of neo-Aristotelian virtue ethics raises the question of the unity of virtues whether virtues form a single interconnected whole or can exist in isolation with Aristotle arguing for the unity of virtues through the central role of practical wisdom as a coordinator of virtues.
answers: She argued that the concept of neo-Aristotelian virtue ethics raises the question of the unity of virtues whether virtues form a single interconnected whole or can exist in isolation with Aristotle arguing for the unity of virtues through the central role of practical wisdom as a coordinator of virtues.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de cercle vertueux en sciences sociales décrit des boucles de rétroaction auto-renforçantes où les résultats positifs renforcent les conditions qui les ont produits en opposition aux cercles vicieux où les résultats négatifs affaiblissent les conditions qui produisent des résultats positifs.
hint: He contended that the concept of a virtuous circle or virtuous cycle in social science describes self-reinforcing feedback loops where positive outcomes strengthen the conditions that produced them as opposed to vicious circles where negative outcomes weaken the conditions that produce positive outcomes.
answers: He contended that the concept of a virtuous circle or virtuous cycle in social science describes self-reinforcing feedback loops where positive outcomes strengthen the conditions that produced them as opposed to vicious circles where negative outcomes weaken the conditions that produce positive outcomes.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la complexité et de la théorie du chaos examine les propriétés émergentes des systèmes dynamiques complexes l'effet papillon et la sensibilité aux conditions initiales et soulève des questions sur la prévisibilité le déterminisme et le niveau d'analyse approprié pour les phénomènes sociaux et naturels.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of complexity and chaos theory examines the emergent properties of complex dynamical systems the butterfly effect and sensitivity to initial conditions and raises questions about predictability determinism and the appropriate level of analysis for social and natural phenomena.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of complexity and chaos theory examines the emergent properties of complex dynamical systems the butterfly effect and sensitivity to initial conditions and raises questions about predictability determinism and the appropriate level of analysis for social and natural phenomena.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'inférence abductive ou rétroduction dans le raisonnement scientifique décrit l'inférence depuis les phénomènes observés vers la meilleure hypothèse qui les expliquerait et que cette forme de raisonnement est centrale à la découverte scientifique à la formation de théories et à l'inférence causale.
hint: He argued that the concept of abductive inference or retroduction in scientific reasoning describes the inference from observed phenomena to the best hypothesis that would explain them and that this form of reasoning is central to scientific discovery theory formation and causal inference.
answers: He argued that the concept of abductive inference or retroduction in scientific reasoning describes the inference from observed phenomena to the best hypothesis that would explain them and that this form of reasoning is central to scientific discovery theory formation and causal inference.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de modèles causaux structurels, développé par Pearl, fournit un cadre mathématique pour raisonner sur la causation les interventions et les contrefactuels permettant aux scientifiques de distinguer la corrélation de la causation et d'identifier les effets causaux depuis les données observationnelles sous certaines conditions.
hint: She contended that the concept of structural causal models, developed by Pearl, provides a mathematical framework for reasoning about causation interventions and counterfactuals enabling scientists to distinguish correlation from causation and to identify causal effects from observational data under certain conditions.
answers: She contended that the concept of structural causal models, developed by Pearl, provides a mathematical framework for reasoning about causation interventions and counterfactuals enabling scientists to distinguish correlation from causation and to identify causal effects from observational data under certain conditions.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'essais contrôlés randomisés comme étalon-or de l'inférence causale soulève des questions philosophiques sur la validité externe la généralisabilité des résultats des conditions expérimentales aux conditions réelles et si les ECR sont toujours la méthode la plus appropriée pour l'inférence causale.
hint: He maintained that the concept of randomized controlled trials as the gold standard for causal inference raises philosophical questions about external validity the generalizability of results from experimental to real-world conditions and whether RCTs are always the most appropriate method for causal inference.
answers: He maintained that the concept of randomized controlled trials as the gold standard for causal inference raises philosophical questions about external validity the generalizability of results from experimental to real-world conditions and whether RCTs are always the most appropriate method for causal inference.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de mécanisme en philosophie des sciences décrit une structure qui produit un phénomène à travers des entités et des activités causales organisées et que l'explication mécaniste est devenue une forme centrale d'explication scientifique en biologie en neuroscience et en sciences sociales.
hint: She argued that the concept of mechanism in the philosophy of science describes a structure that produces a phenomenon through organized causal entities and activities and that mechanistic explanation has become a central form of scientific explanation in biology neuroscience and social science.
answers: She argued that the concept of mechanism in the philosophy of science describes a structure that produces a phenomenon through organized causal entities and activities and that mechanistic explanation has become a central form of scientific explanation in biology neuroscience and social science.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de robustesse en philosophie des sciences décrit la confirmation d'un résultat par de multiples méthodes indépendantes et que les résultats robustes sont plus susceptibles d'être réels plutôt que des artefacts d'une méthode particulière de mesure ou d'analyse.
hint: He contended that the concept of robustness in philosophy of science describes the confirmation of a result by multiple independent methods and that robust results are more likely to be real rather than artefacts of any particular method of measurement or analysis.
answers: He contended that the concept of robustness in philosophy of science describes the confirmation of a result by multiple independent methods and that robust results are more likely to be real rather than artefacts of any particular method of measurement or analysis.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de sous-détermination en philosophie des sciences soutient que les preuves disponibles sont toujours compatibles avec de multiples théories concurrentes et que cela crée un écart permanent entre ce que les preuves montrent et quelle théorie est vraie requérant des critères non-évidentiels pour le choix de théorie.
hint: She maintained that the concept of underdetermination in philosophy of science holds that the available evidence is always compatible with multiple competing theories and that this creates a permanent gap between what evidence shows and which theory is true requiring non-evidential criteria for theory choice.
answers: She maintained that the concept of underdetermination in philosophy of science holds that the available evidence is always compatible with multiple competing theories and that this creates a permanent gap between what evidence shows and which theory is true requiring non-evidential criteria for theory choice.

en: Il a soutenu que la thèse Duhem-Quine soutient que les hypothèses scientifiques ne peuvent pas être testées individuellement parce qu'elles font toujours face aux preuves conjointement avec des présuppositions de fond de sorte que lorsqu'une prédiction échoue il est toujours possible de protéger l'hypothèse en révisant les présuppositions auxiliaires à la place.
hint: He argued that the Duhem-Quine thesis holds that scientific hypotheses cannot be tested individually because they always face evidence in conjunction with background assumptions so that when a prediction fails it is always possible to protect the hypothesis by revising auxiliary assumptions instead.
answers: He argued that the Duhem-Quine thesis holds that scientific hypotheses cannot be tested individually because they always face evidence in conjunction with background assumptions so that when a prediction fails it is always possible to protect the hypothesis by revising auxiliary assumptions instead.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de charge théorique de l'observation soutient que les observations sont toujours déjà façonnées par des engagements théoriques de sorte qu'il n'y a pas de base observationnelle théoriquement neutre et que cela a des implications pour l'idéal de la science objective.
hint: She contended that the concept of theory ladenness of observation holds that observations are always already shaped by theoretical commitments so that there is no theory-neutral observational base and that this has implications for the ideal of objective science.
answers: She contended that the concept of theory ladenness of observation holds that observations are always already shaped by theoretical commitments so that there is no theory-neutral observational base and that this has implications for the ideal of objective science.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de modèle en philosophie des sciences décrit des structures abstraites qui représentent des aspects du monde sans être identiques à lui et soulève des questions sur la nature de la relation entre modèles et réalité si les modèles sont des cartes des fictions ou des vérités partielles.
hint: He maintained that the concept of model in philosophy of science describes abstract structures that represent aspects of the world without being identical to it and raises questions about what the relationship between models and reality is whether models are maps fictions or partial truths.
answers: He maintained that the concept of model in philosophy of science describes abstract structures that represent aspects of the world without being identical to it and raises questions about what the relationship between models and reality is whether models are maps fictions or partial truths.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'idéalisation en science décrit la façon dont les modèles scientifiques déforment délibérément la réalité pour simplifier l'analyse les plans sans friction les gaz parfaits et les agents rationnels étant des idéalisations classiques soulevant des questions philosophiques sur la façon dont les modèles idéalisés peuvent produire une véritable compréhension de la réalité non idéale.
hint: She argued that the concept of idealization in science describes the way scientific models deliberately distort reality to simplify analysis with frictionless planes ideal gases and rational agents being classic idealizations raising philosophical questions about how idealized models can produce genuine understanding of non-ideal reality.
answers: She argued that the concept of idealization in science describes the way scientific models deliberately distort reality to simplify analysis with frictionless planes ideal gases and rational agents being classic idealizations raising philosophical questions about how idealized models can produce genuine understanding of non-ideal reality.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de l'informatique examine la nature du calcul si le calcul est indépendant du substrat ce que la thèse de Church-Turing implique sur les limites du calcul et si les modèles computationnels peuvent capturer toutes les formes de traitement d'information intelligent et biologique.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of computer science examines the nature of computation whether computation is substrate-independent what the Church-Turing thesis implies about the limits of computation and whether computational models can capture all forms of intelligent and biological information processing.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of computer science examines the nature of computation whether computation is substrate-independent what the Church-Turing thesis implies about the limits of computation and whether computational models can capture all forms of intelligent and biological information processing.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de théorie de la complexité computationnelle décrit la classification des problèmes computationnels par les ressources requises pour les résoudre avec les problèmes en P solubles en temps polynomial et les problèmes en NP vérifiables en temps polynomial soulevant la célèbre question P versus NP.
hint: She maintained that the concept of computational complexity theory describes the classification of computational problems by the resources required to solve them with problems in P solvable in polynomial time and problems in NP verifiable in polynomial time raising the famous P versus NP question.
answers: She maintained that the concept of computational complexity theory describes the classification of computational problems by the resources required to solve them with problems in P solvable in polynomial time and problems in NP verifiable in polynomial time raising the famous P versus NP question.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de calcul quantique soulève des questions philosophiques sur la nature du calcul l'interprétation de la mécanique quantique et si les ordinateurs quantiques sont genuinement différents des ordinateurs classiques dans leur capacité à résoudre efficacement certains problèmes computationnels.
hint: He argued that the concept of quantum computing raises philosophical questions about the nature of computation the interpretation of quantum mechanics and whether quantum computers are genuinely different from classical computers in their ability to solve certain computational problems efficiently.
answers: He argued that the concept of quantum computing raises philosophical questions about the nature of computation the interpretation of quantum mechanics and whether quantum computers are genuinely different from classical computers in their ability to solve certain computational problems efficiently.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de l'information examine ce qu'est l'information comment elle se rapporte à la connaissance à la vérité et au sens et quelles sont les implications éthiques de l'accès universel à l'information du filtrage et de la surveillance pour la démocratie la liberté et l'épanouissement humain.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of information examines what information is how it relates to knowledge truth and meaning and what the ethical implications of universal information access filtering and surveillance are for democracy freedom and human flourishing.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of information examines what information is how it relates to knowledge truth and meaning and what the ethical implications of universal information access filtering and surveillance are for democracy freedom and human flourishing.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept le médium est le message associé à Marshall McLuhan soutient que la forme et la technologie de la communication façonnent et transforment l'organisation sociale et la cognition humaine indépendamment du contenu que le médium transmet.
hint: He maintained that the concept of the medium is the message associated with Marshall McLuhan holds that the form and technology of communication shapes and transforms social organisation and human cognition independently of the content that the medium transmits.
answers: He maintained that the concept of the medium is the message associated with Marshall McLuhan holds that the form and technology of communication shapes and transforms social organisation and human cognition independently of the content that the medium transmits.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'écologie des médias, associé à McLuhan, Postman et Mumford, examine comment différentes technologies médiatiques créent différents environnements cognitifs et sociaux et comment l'introduction de nouveaux médias transforme les cultures existantes les pratiques et les structures sociales.
hint: She argued that the concept of media ecology, associated with McLuhan Postman and Mumford, examines how different media technologies create different cognitive and social environments and how the introduction of new media transforms existing cultures practices and social structures.
answers: She argued that the concept of media ecology, associated with McLuhan Postman and Mumford, examines how different media technologies create different cognitive and social environments and how the introduction of new media transforms existing cultures practices and social structures.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de sphère publique en réseau, étudié par Yochai Benkler, décrit comment internet et les médias sociaux ont créé de nouvelles possibilités pour la production médiatique participative et le discours public mais aussi de nouveaux risques de polarisation de désinformation et de fragmentation de la conversation publique.
hint: He contended that the concept of the networked public sphere, studied by Yochai Benkler, describes how the internet and social media have created new possibilities for participatory media production and public discourse but also new risks of polarisation misinformation and fragmentation of public conversation.
answers: He contended that the concept of the networked public sphere, studied by Yochai Benkler, describes how the internet and social media have created new possibilities for participatory media production and public discourse but also new risks of polarisation misinformation and fragmentation of public conversation.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de technologie deepfake soulève des questions philosophiques sur la nature de la preuve l'épistémologie du témoignage et les conditions sociales de la confiance notant que les technologies capables de produire des vidéos fausses convaincantes sapent le rôle probatoire des preuves visuelles.
hint: She maintained that the concept of deep fake technology raises philosophical questions about the nature of evidence the epistemics of testimony and the social conditions of trust noting that technologies that can produce convincing false videos undermine the evidential role of visual evidence.
answers: She maintained that the concept of deep fake technology raises philosophical questions about the nature of evidence the epistemics of testimony and the social conditions of trust noting that technologies that can produce convincing false videos undermine the evidential role of visual evidence.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de post-vérité en philosophie politique contemporaine décrit la condition dans laquelle les appels à l'émotion et à la croyance personnelle sont devenus plus influents que les faits et les preuves objectives dans la formation de l'opinion publique et de la prise de décision politique créant des défis pour la délibération démocratique.
hint: He argued that the concept of post-truth in contemporary political philosophy describes the condition in which appeals to emotion and personal belief have become more influential than facts and objective evidence in shaping public opinion and political decision-making creating challenges for democratic deliberation.
answers: He argued that the concept of post-truth in contemporary political philosophy describes the condition in which appeals to emotion and personal belief have become more influential than facts and objective evidence in shaping public opinion and political decision-making creating challenges for democratic deliberation.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie des fausses nouvelles examine les dimensions épistémologiques et éthiques de la désinformation répandue à travers les médias sociaux et numériques et s'il existe un devoir civique de chercher la vérité de réfuter les faussetés ou de s'abstenir de répandre la désinformation.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of fake news examines the epistemological and ethical dimensions of false information spread through social and digital media and whether there is a civic duty to seek truth debunk falsehoods or refrain from spreading misinformation.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of fake news examines the epistemological and ethical dimensions of false information spread through social and digital media and whether there is a civic duty to seek truth debunk falsehoods or refrain from spreading misinformation.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'autonomie épistémique décrit la capacité de l'individu à former des croyances à travers ses propres processus cognitifs plutôt que par dépendance aux autorités épistémiques et que internet et les médias sociaux soulèvent des questions sur s'ils renforcent ou sapent l'autonomie épistémique.
hint: He maintained that the concept of epistemic autonomy describes the individual's capacity to form beliefs through one's own cognitive processes rather than through dependence on epistemic authorities and that the internet and social media raise questions about whether they enhance or undermine epistemic autonomy.
answers: He maintained that the concept of epistemic autonomy describes the individual's capacity to form beliefs through one's own cognitive processes rather than through dependence on epistemic authorities and that the internet and social media raise questions about whether they enhance or undermine epistemic autonomy.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de chambres d'écho et de bulles de filtres soulève des préoccupations épistémologiques sur la façon dont les algorithmes des médias sociaux sélectionnent les contenus qui renforcent les croyances existantes créant des environnements informationnels qui réduisent l'exposition aux points de vue différents et peuvent contribuer à la polarisation politique.
hint: She argued that the concept of echo chambers and filter bubbles raises epistemological concerns about how social media algorithms select content that reinforces existing beliefs creating information environments that reduce exposure to challenging views and may contribute to political polarisation.
answers: She argued that the concept of echo chambers and filter bubbles raises epistemological concerns about how social media algorithms select content that reinforces existing beliefs creating information environments that reduce exposure to challenging views and may contribute to political polarisation.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la race et du genre examine si la race et le genre sont des genres naturels des faits biologiques des constructions sociales ou des genres interactifs qui sont à la fois socialement construits et ont des effets biologiques montrant que les questions ontologiques et normatives sur ces catégories sont inséparables.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of race and gender examines whether race and gender are natural kinds biological facts social constructions or interactive kinds that are both socially constructed and have biological effects showing that ontological and normative questions about these categories are inseparable.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of race and gender examines whether race and gender are natural kinds biological facts social constructions or interactive kinds that are both socially constructed and have biological effects showing that ontological and normative questions about these categories are inseparable.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de performativité du genre dans la philosophie de Judith Butler soutient que le genre n'est pas une essence naturelle mais est constitué à travers des performances stylisées répétées d'actes gestes et enactements qui produisent l'apparence d'une identité de genre substantielle.
hint: She maintained that the concept of gender performativity in Judith Butler's philosophy holds that gender is not a natural essence but is constituted through repeated stylized performances of acts gestures and enactments that produce the appearance of a substantial gender identity.
answers: She maintained that the concept of gender performativity in Judith Butler's philosophy holds that gender is not a natural essence but is constituted through repeated stylized performances of acts gestures and enactments that produce the appearance of a substantial gender identity.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de la distinction sexe-genre, introduit par les théoriciennes féministes, soutient que le sexe désigne les caractéristiques biologiques tandis que le genre désigne les rôles comportements et identités socialement construits avec des débats ultérieurs sur la question de savoir si cette distinction est philosophiquement soutenable.
hint: He argued that the concept of the sex-gender distinction, introduced by feminist theorists, holds that sex refers to biological characteristics while gender refers to socially constructed roles behaviors and identities with subsequent debates about whether this distinction is philosophically sustainable.
answers: He argued that the concept of the sex-gender distinction, introduced by feminist theorists, holds that sex refers to biological characteristics while gender refers to socially constructed roles behaviors and identities with subsequent debates about whether this distinction is philosophically sustainable.

en: Elle a soutenu que la théorie queer, s'appuyant sur Butler Sedgwick Foucault et d'autres, remet en question la naturalisation de l'hétérosexualité et des normes de genre binaires, soutenant que ces catégories sont historiquement et discursivement produites et que les identités queer résistent à l'assimilation dans des catégories fixes.
hint: She contended that queer theory, drawing on Butler Sedgwick Foucault and others, challenges the naturalisation of heterosexuality and binary gender norms arguing that these categories are historically and discursively produced and that queer identities resist assimilation to fixed categories.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de preuve mathématique soulève des questions philosophiques sur ce qui constitue une preuve si les preuves assistées par ordinateur qui ne peuvent pas être vérifiées humainement comptent comme de véritables preuves quel rôle joue l'intuition dans la compréhension mathématique et si la dimension sociale de la pratique mathématique affecte ce qui compte comme prouvé.
hint: She maintained that the concept of mathematical proof raises philosophical questions about what constitutes proof whether computer-assisted proofs that cannot be humanly verified count as genuine proofs what role intuition plays in mathematical understanding and whether the social dimension of mathematical practice affects what counts as proven.
answers: She maintained that the concept of mathematical proof raises philosophical questions about what constitutes proof whether computer-assisted proofs that cannot be humanly verified count as genuine proofs what role intuition plays in mathematical understanding and whether the social dimension of mathematical practice affects what counts as proven.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de vérité mathématique soulève des questions profondes sur la relation entre la vérité mathématique et la prouvabilité compte tenu des théorèmes de Gödel montrant qu'elles peuvent diverger et si les vérités mathématiques qui sont indépendantes d'un système formel ont une valeur de vérité déterminée.
hint: He argued that the concept of mathematical truth raises deep questions about the relationship between mathematical truth and provability given Gödel's theorems showing that they can come apart and whether mathematical truths that are independent of a formal system have a determinate truth value.
answers: He argued that the concept of mathematical truth raises deep questions about the relationship between mathematical truth and provability given Gödel's theorems showing that they can come apart and whether mathematical truths that are independent of a formal system have a determinate truth value.

en: Elle a soutenu que l'applicabilité des mathématiques au monde naturel comme Wigner l'a décrit soulève l'efficacité déraisonnable des mathématiques comme un puzzle philosophique si les structures mathématiques découvertes par la raison pure décrivent la réalité physique parce que l'univers est mathématique parce que les mathématiques sont suffisamment flexibles ou en raison d'une connexion non découverte.
hint: She contended that the applicability of mathematics to the natural world as Wigner described raises the unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics as a philosophical puzzle whether mathematical structures discovered through pure reason describe physical reality because the universe is mathematical because mathematics is sufficiently flexible or because of an undiscovered connection.
answers: She contended that the applicability of mathematics to the natural world as Wigner described raises the unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics as a philosophical puzzle whether mathematical structures discovered through pure reason describe physical reality because the universe is mathematical because mathematics is sufficiently flexible or because of an undiscovered connection.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la probabilité est divisée entre les interprétations fréquentistes soutenant que la probabilité est la fréquence limite des résultats dans des essais répétés et les interprétations subjectives ou bayésiennes soutenant que la probabilité représente des degrés de croyance qui devraient être mis à jour selon le théorème de Bayes à mesure que de nouvelles preuves arrivent.
hint: He maintained that the philosophy of probability is divided between frequentist interpretations holding that probability is the limiting frequency of outcomes in repeated trials and subjective or Bayesian interpretations holding that probability represents degrees of belief that should be updated according to Bayes's theorem as new evidence arrives.
answers: He maintained that the philosophy of probability is divided between frequentist interpretations holding that probability is the limiting frequency of outcomes in repeated trials and subjective or Bayesian interpretations holding that probability represents degrees of belief that should be updated according to Bayes's theorem as new evidence arrives.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de causalité en philosophie est analysé à travers les théories de la régularité soutenant que la causalité est une succession régulière les théories contrefactuelles soutenant que la causalité est une dépendance contrefactuelle et les théories interventionnistes soutenant que la causalité concerne ce qui se passerait sous des interventions possibles chacune avec des forces et des difficultés distinctes.
hint: She argued that the concept of causation in philosophy is analysed through regularity theories holding that causation is regular succession counterfactual theories holding that causation is counterfactual dependence and interventionist theories holding that causation is about what would happen under possible interventions each with distinct strengths and difficulties.
answers: She argued that the concept of causation in philosophy is analysed through regularity theories holding that causation is regular succession counterfactual theories holding that causation is counterfactual dependence and interventionist theories holding that causation is about what would happen under possible interventions each with distinct strengths and difficulties.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'émergence en philosophie des sciences et en métaphysique désigne les propriétés ou les patterns qui émergent de l'interaction de composants de niveau inférieur mais ne peuvent pas être réduits aux propriétés de ces composants ni prédits à partir de celles-ci remettant en cause le physicalisme réductif et soulevant des questions sur les niveaux de description.
hint: He contended that the concept of emergence in philosophy of science and metaphysics refers to properties or patterns that arise from the interaction of lower-level components but cannot be reduced to or predicted from the properties of those components alone challenging reductive physicalism and raising questions about levels of description.
answers: He contended that the concept of emergence in philosophy of science and metaphysics refers to properties or patterns that arise from the interaction of lower-level components but cannot be reduced to or predicted from the properties of those components alone challenging reductive physicalism and raising questions about levels of description.

en: Elle a soutenu que la théorie de la régularité de la causalité associée à Hume soutient que la causalité n'est rien d'autre que la conjonction constante d'événements où un type suit régulièrement un autre sans aucune connexion nécessaire ce compte déflationniste fait face à des objections du problème des corrélations fallacieuses et de l'asymétrie de la causalité.
hint: She maintained that the regularity theory of causation associated with Hume holds that causation is nothing but constant conjunction of events where one type regularly follows another without any necessary connection this deflationary account faces objections from the problem of spurious correlations and the asymmetry of causation.
answers: She maintained that the regularity theory of causation associated with Hume holds that causation is nothing but constant conjunction of events where one type regularly follows another without any necessary connection this deflationary account faces objections from the problem of spurious correlations and the asymmetry of causation.

en: Il a soutenu que la théorie contrefactuelle de la causalité associée à Lewis soutient que l'événement A cause l'événement B si et seulement si si A n'avait pas eu lieu B n'aurait pas eu lieu ce compte capture l'asymétrie de la causalité mais fait face au défi des cas de préemption où des causes de secours auraient produit l'effet de toute façon.
hint: He argued that the counterfactual theory of causation associated with Lewis holds that event A causes event B if and only if if A had not occurred B would not have occurred this account captures the asymmetry of causation but faces the challenge of preemption cases where backup causes would have produced the effect anyway.
answers: He argued that the counterfactual theory of causation associated with Lewis holds that event A causes event B if and only if if A had not occurred B would not have occurred this account captures the asymmetry of causation but faces the challenge of preemption cases where backup causes would have produced the effect anyway.

en: Elle a soutenu que les théories interventionnistes de la causalité associées à Woodward soutiennent que les relations causales sont définies par l'invariance sous les interventions de sorte que X cause Y si intervenir pour changer X changerait Y ce compte rend la causalité empiriquement tractable mais soulève des questions sur la nature des interventions et leur indépendance par rapport aux conditions de fond.
hint: She contended that interventionist theories of causation associated with Woodward hold that causal relationships are defined by invariance under interventions such that X causes Y if intervening to change X would change Y this account makes causation empirically tractable but raises questions about the nature of interventions and their independence from background conditions.
answers: She contended that interventionist theories of causation associated with Woodward hold that causal relationships are defined by invariance under interventions such that X causes Y if intervening to change X would change Y this account makes causation empirically tractable but raises questions about the nature of interventions and their independence from background conditions.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'identité personnelle à travers le temps soulève des questions sur ce qui fait qu'une personne est la même personne au fil du temps les théories de la continuité psychologique soutenant que l'identité personnelle consiste en des chaînes se chevauchant de mémoire et de connexité psychologique et les théories biologiques soutenant que l'identité personnelle consiste en la continuité corporelle ou biologique.
hint: He maintained that the concept of personal identity through time raises questions about what makes a person the same person over time with psychological continuity theories holding that personal identity consists in overlapping chains of memory and psychological connectedness and biological theories holding that personal identity consists in bodily or biological continuity.
answers: He maintained that the concept of personal identity through time raises questions about what makes a person the same person over time with psychological continuity theories holding that personal identity consists in overlapping chains of memory and psychological connectedness and biological theories holding that personal identity consists in bodily or biological continuity.

en: Elle a soutenu que le réductionnisme de Parfit sur l'identité personnelle soutient que les faits sur l'identité personnelle consistent dans l'obtention de faits plus particuliers sur la continuité et la connexité psychologique et que l'identité personnelle n'est pas ce qui compte pour la survie ce qui compte c'est la continuité psychologique qu'elle prenne ou non une forme ramifiée.
hint: She argued that Parfit's reductionism about personal identity holds that facts about personal identity consist in the obtaining of more particular facts about psychological continuity and connectedness and that personal identity is not what matters in survival what matters is psychological continuity whether or not it takes a branching form.
answers: She argued that Parfit's reductionism about personal identity holds that facts about personal identity consist in the obtaining of more particular facts about psychological continuity and connectedness and that personal identity is not what matters in survival what matters is psychological continuity whether or not it takes a branching form.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la mort examine si la mort est un préjudice pour la personne qui meurt le compte de la privation soutenant que la mort nuit en retirant de bonnes expériences en contraste avec l'argument épicurien que la mort n'est pas un préjudice parce que quand la mort est là nous n'y sommes pas et quand nous y sommes la mort n'est pas là.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of death examines whether death is a harm for the person who dies the deprivation account holding that death harms by removing good experiences contrasted with the Epicurean argument that death is not a harm because when death is we are not and when we are death is not.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of death examines whether death is a harm for the person who dies the deprivation account holding that death harms by removing good experiences contrasted with the Epicurean argument that death is not a harm because when death is we are not and when we are death is not.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'immortalité soulève des questions philosophiques sur si une vie immortelle serait désirable Williams soutenant que l'immortalité deviendrait finalement ennuyeuse parce que ce qui rend nos désirs catégoriques valables à poursuivre est lié à une vie particulière finie et l'immortalité épuiserait finalement toutes les expériences possibles et les sources de sens.
hint: She maintained that the concept of immortality raises philosophical questions about whether an immortal life would be desirable Williams arguing that immortality would ultimately become tedious because what makes our categorical desires worth pursuing is tied to a particular finite life and immortality would eventually exhaust all possible experiences and sources of meaning.
answers: She maintained that the concept of immortality raises philosophical questions about whether an immortal life would be desirable Williams arguing that immortality would ultimately become tedious because what makes our categorical desires worth pursuing is tied to a particular finite life and immortality would eventually exhaust all possible experiences and sources of meaning.

en: Il a soutenu que le pragmatisme développé par Peirce James et Dewey soutient que la signification d'un concept consiste en ses conséquences pratiques que la vérité est ce qui fonctionne à long terme et que l'enquête est une pratique sociale visant à résoudre de véritables doutes plutôt qu'à atteindre une correspondance avec une réalité indépendante de l'esprit.
hint: He argued that pragmatism as developed by Peirce James and Dewey holds that the meaning of a concept consists in its practical consequences that truth is what works in the long run and that inquiry is a social practice aimed at resolving genuine doubts rather than achieving correspondence with a mind-independent reality.
answers: He argued that pragmatism as developed by Peirce James and Dewey holds that the meaning of a concept consists in its practical consequences that truth is what works in the long run and that inquiry is a social practice aimed at resolving genuine doubts rather than achieving correspondence with a mind-independent reality.

en: Elle a soutenu que l'instrumentalisme ou l'expérimentalisme de Dewey soutient que la connaissance est un instrument pour résoudre des problèmes pratiques que l'enquête est gouvernée par la logique de la situation plutôt que par des principes a priori et que la vie démocratique et la pratique éducative devraient être reconstruites sur la base de la méthode scientifique et d'attitudes expérimentales.
hint: She contended that Dewey's instrumentalism or experimentalism holds that knowledge is an instrument for solving practical problems that inquiry is governed by the logic of the situation rather than a priori principles and that democratic life and educational practice should be reconstructed on the basis of scientific method and experimental attitudes.
answers: She contended that Dewey's instrumentalism or experimentalism holds that knowledge is an instrument for solving practical problems that inquiry is governed by the logic of the situation rather than a priori principles and that democratic life and educational practice should be reconstructed on the basis of scientific method and experimental attitudes.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de vérité dans le pragmatisme est analysé différemment par ses principaux partisans avec Peirce identifiant la vérité à l'opinion finale sur laquelle l'enquête convergerait à long terme James identifiant la vérité à ce qu'il est bon de croire et Dewey traitant la vérité comme le résultat de l'assertabilité garantie plutôt que de la correspondance.
hint: He maintained that the concept of truth in pragmatism is analysed differently by its main proponents with Peirce identifying truth with the final opinion that inquiry would converge on in the long run James identifying truth with what is good to believe and Dewey treating truth as the result of warranted assertibility rather than correspondence.
answers: He maintained that the concept of truth in pragmatism is analysed differently by its main proponents with Peirce identifying truth with the final opinion that inquiry would converge on in the long run James identifying truth with what is good to believe and Dewey treating truth as the result of warranted assertibility rather than correspondence.

en: Elle a soutenu que la théorie des signes ou sémiotique de Peirce distingue entre le signe l'objet auquel il se réfère et l'interprétant la signification ou l'effet produit dans l'esprit de l'interprète formant une relation triadique qui diffère fondamentalement de la théorie dyadique du signe du structuralisme de Saussure.
hint: She argued that Peirce's theory of signs or semiotics distinguishes between the sign the object it refers to and the interpretant the meaning or effect produced in the mind of the interpreter forming a triadic relation that differs fundamentally from the dyadic sign theory of Saussure's structuralism.
answers: She argued that Peirce's theory of signs or semiotics distinguishes between the sign the object it refers to and the interpretant the meaning or effect produced in the mind of the interpreter forming a triadic relation that differs fundamentally from the dyadic sign theory of Saussure's structuralism.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du langage ordinaire associée à Austin Ryle et au travail ultérieur de Wittgenstein soutient que de nombreux problèmes philosophiques surgissent de malentendus sur la façon dont le langage ordinaire fonctionne réellement et peuvent être dissous par une attention soigneuse à l'utilisation réelle des mots dans des contextes ordinaires plutôt que par une analyse théorique formelle.
hint: He contended that ordinary language philosophy associated with Austin Ryle and Wittgenstein's later work holds that many philosophical problems arise from misunderstandings of how ordinary language actually works and can be dissolved by careful attention to the actual use of words in ordinary contexts rather than through formal theoretical analysis.
answers: He contended that ordinary language philosophy associated with Austin Ryle and Wittgenstein's later work holds that many philosophical problems arise from misunderstandings of how ordinary language actually works and can be dissolved by careful attention to the actual use of words in ordinary contexts rather than through formal theoretical analysis.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'erreur de catégorie de Ryle soutient que les problèmes philosophiques surgissent souvent du fait de traiter des concepts appartenant à une catégorie logique comme s'ils appartenaient à une catégorie différente comme traiter les états mentaux comme s'ils étaient des objets internes privés comme des états physiques dans un espace intérieur caché.
hint: She maintained that Ryle's concept of the category mistake holds that philosophical problems often arise from treating concepts belonging to one logical category as if they belonged to a different category such as treating mental states as if they were private internal objects like physical states in a hidden inner space.
answers: She maintained that Ryle's concept of the category mistake holds that philosophical problems often arise from treating concepts belonging to one logical category as if they belonged to a different category such as treating mental states as if they were private internal objects like physical states in a hidden inner space.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de l'éducation examine les objectifs de l'éducation qu'il s'agisse de transmettre le patrimoine culturel de favoriser l'autonomie individuelle et la pensée critique de développer le caractère et la vertu ou de préparer les citoyens à la participation démocratique et comment différentes philosophies éducatives intègrent des engagements distincts sur l'épanouissement humain et la justice sociale.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of education examines the aims of education whether they are to transmit cultural heritage to foster individual autonomy and critical thinking to develop character and virtue or to prepare citizens for democratic participation and how different educational philosophies embed distinct commitments about human flourishing and social justice.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of education examines the aims of education whether they are to transmit cultural heritage to foster individual autonomy and critical thinking to develop character and virtue or to prepare citizens for democratic participation and how different educational philosophies embed distinct commitments about human flourishing and social justice.

en: Elle a soutenu que le débat sur l'endoctrinement en philosophie de l'éducation examine ce qui distingue l'enseignement légitime de l'endoctrinement avec des comptes basés sur des critères portant sur si le contenu enseigné est vrai si les méthodes utilisées contournent l'évaluation rationnelle et si les élèves reçoivent les raisons des croyances plutôt qu'on leur dit simplement de les accepter.
hint: She contended that the indoctrination debate in philosophy of education examines what distinguishes legitimate teaching from indoctrination with criterion-based accounts focusing on whether the content taught is true the methods used bypass rational evaluation and whether students are given the reasons for beliefs rather than being simply told to accept them.
answers: She contended that the indoctrination debate in philosophy of education examines what distinguishes legitimate teaching from indoctrination with criterion-based accounts focusing on whether the content taught is true the methods used bypass rational evaluation and whether students are given the reasons for beliefs rather than being simply told to accept them.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'autonomie épistémique dans l'éducation soutient qu'un objectif central de l'éducation devrait être de développer la capacité des élèves à former leurs propres jugements raisonnés indépendamment de l'autorité et que les approches éducatives qui sapent l'autonomie épistémique par la déférence à l'autorité ou l'apprentissage par cœur sont éducativement déficientes.
hint: He maintained that the concept of epistemic autonomy in education holds that a central aim of education should be to develop students capacity to form their own reasoned judgements independently of authority and that educational approaches that undermine epistemic autonomy through deference to authority or rote learning are educationally deficient.
answers: He maintained that the concept of epistemic autonomy in education holds that a central aim of education should be to develop students capacity to form their own reasoned judgements independently of authority and that educational approaches that undermine epistemic autonomy through deference to authority or rote learning are educationally deficient.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie du sport examine ce qui définit le sport comme une pratique humaine distincte si les technologies d'amélioration des performances changent la nature essentielle de l'accomplissement athlétique l'éthique du risque dans le sport et si le sport a une valeur intrinsèque ou est seulement valable instrumentalement pour la santé la cohésion sociale ou l'identité nationale.
hint: She argued that the philosophy of sport examines what defines sport as a distinct human practice whether performance-enhancing technologies change the essential nature of athletic achievement the ethics of risk in sport and whether sport has intrinsic value or is valuable only instrumentally for health social cohesion or national identity.
answers: She argued that the philosophy of sport examines what defines sport as a distinct human practice whether performance-enhancing technologies change the essential nature of athletic achievement the ethics of risk in sport and whether sport has intrinsic value or is valuable only instrumentally for health social cohesion or national identity.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de triche dans le sport soulève des questions philosophiques sur si les violations de règles et le jeu stratégique sont catégoriquement distincts ou ne diffèrent que par degré sur la relation entre les règles écrites et l'esprit d'un sport et si les drogues améliorant les performances devraient être interdites ou acceptées comme continues avec la culture existante d'optimisation des performances.
hint: He contended that the concept of cheating in sport raises philosophical questions about whether rule violations and strategic gamesmanship are categorically distinct or differ only in degree about the relationship between the written rules and the spirit of a sport and whether performance-enhancing drugs should be prohibited or accepted as continuous with the existing culture of performance optimisation.
answers: He contended that the concept of cheating in sport raises philosophical questions about whether rule violations and strategic gamesmanship are categorically distinct or differ only in degree about the relationship between the written rules and the spirit of a sport and whether performance-enhancing drugs should be prohibited or accepted as continuous with the existing culture of performance optimisation.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de jeu équitable dans le sport examine si l'égalité des chances exige d'égaliser les talents naturels l'équipement ou les ressources économiques entre les compétiteurs et si l'idéal méritocratique dans le sport est compatible avec les énormes différences de ressources économiques et d'accès aux installations d'entraînement d'élite entre les athlètes de différents milieux.
hint: She maintained that the concept of fair play in sport examines whether equality of opportunity requires equalising natural talents equipment or economic resources behind competitors and whether the meritocratic ideal in sport is compatible with the enormous differences in economic resources and access to elite training facilities across athletes from different backgrounds.
answers: She maintained that the concept of fair play in sport examines whether equality of opportunity requires equalising natural talents equipment or economic resources behind competitors and whether the meritocratic ideal in sport is compatible with the enormous differences in economic resources and access to elite training facilities across athletes from different backgrounds.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de racisme systémique distingue entre les actes individuels de préjugé racial et les patterns structurels ou institutionnels d'inégalité raciale enchâssés dans les lois les politiques et les normes sociales qui désavantagent les minorités raciales même sans la présence d'une intention raciste explicite chez un décideur individuel.
hint: He argued that the concept of systemic racism distinguishes between individual acts of racial prejudice and structural or institutional patterns of racial inequality embedded in laws policies and social norms that disadvantage racial minorities even without the presence of explicit racist intent in any individual decision-maker.
answers: He argued that the concept of systemic racism distinguishes between individual acts of racial prejudice and structural or institutional patterns of racial inequality embedded in laws policies and social norms that disadvantage racial minorities even without the presence of explicit racist intent in any individual decision-maker.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de privilège blanc examiné par Peggy McIntosh désigne les avantages largement invisibles que les personnes blanches reçoivent dans des sociétés structurées par le racisme historique y compris des avantages dans les interactions avec la police le système judiciaire le logement l'emploi et l'éducation que les personnes de couleur manquent systématiquement.
hint: She contended that the concept of white privilege examined by Peggy McIntosh refers to the largely invisible advantages that white people receive in societies structured by historical racism including advantages in interactions with police the justice system housing employment and education that people of colour systematically lack.
answers: She contended that the concept of white privilege examined by Peggy McIntosh refers to the largely invisible advantages that white people receive in societies structured by historical racism including advantages in interactions with police the justice system housing employment and education that people of colour systematically lack.

en: Il a soutenu que la théorie critique de la race en tant que mouvement académique juridique et social examine comment la race et le racisme sont socialement construits comment le racisme n'est pas seulement une question de préjugé individuel mais est enchâssé dans les systèmes juridiques et les structures sociales et comment l'intersectionnalité avec le genre la classe et la sexualité complique l'analyse de la justice raciale.
hint: He maintained that critical race theory as an academic legal and social movement examines how race and racism are socially constructed how racism is not merely about individual prejudice but is embedded in legal systems and social structures and how intersectionality with gender class and sexuality complicates the analysis of racial justice.
answers: He maintained that critical race theory as an academic legal and social movement examines how race and racism are socially constructed how racism is not merely about individual prejudice but is embedded in legal systems and social structures and how intersectionality with gender class and sexuality complicates the analysis of racial justice.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de daltonisme comme idéologie dans les relations raciales soutient que la meilleure façon de surmonter le racisme est de traiter les individus sans référence à la race mais les critiques soutiennent que le daltonisme ignore le racisme structurel permet à l'inégalité raciale de persister sans être contestée et reflète une forme de privilège du groupe dominant.
hint: She argued that the concept of colourblindness as an ideology in race relations holds that the best way to overcome racism is to treat individuals without reference to race but critics argue that colourblindness ignores structural racism allows racial inequality to persist unchallenged and reflects a form of dominant group privilege.
answers: She argued that the concept of colourblindness as an ideology in race relations holds that the best way to overcome racism is to treat individuals without reference to race but critics argue that colourblindness ignores structural racism allows racial inequality to persist unchallenged and reflects a form of dominant group privilege.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de réparations pour les injustices historiques soulève des questions philosophiques sur la justice intergénérationnelle si les générations actuelles peuvent être tenues responsables des injustices commises par leurs ancêtres sous quelle forme les réparations devraient être prises et si les réparations traiteraient adéquatement les inégalités structurelles persistantes.
hint: He contended that the concept of reparations for historical injustices raises philosophical questions about intergenerational justice whether present generations can be held responsible for injustices committed by ancestors what form reparations should take and whether reparations would adequately address ongoing structural inequalities.
answers: He contended that the concept of reparations for historical injustices raises philosophical questions about intergenerational justice whether present generations can be held responsible for injustices committed by ancestors what form reparations should take and whether reparations would adequately address ongoing structural inequalities.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de multiculturalisme en philosophie politique développé par Kymlicka soutient que les démocraties libérales devraient reconnaître et accommoder les différences culturelles par des droits différenciés selon les groupes y compris des protections pour les peuples autochtones et les minorités nationales tout en maintenant les droits individuels comme limite ultime sur l'autorité des groupes culturels.
hint: She maintained that the concept of multiculturalism in political philosophy as developed by Kymlicka holds that liberal democracies should recognise and accommodate cultural differences through group-differentiated rights including protections for indigenous peoples and national minorities while maintaining individual rights as the ultimate limit on cultural group authority.
answers: She maintained that the concept of multiculturalism in political philosophy as developed by Kymlicka holds that liberal democracies should recognise and accommodate cultural differences through group-differentiated rights including protections for indigenous peoples and national minorities while maintaining individual rights as the ultimate limit on cultural group authority.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de cosmopolitisme en philosophie politique soutient que tous les êtres humains sont membres d'une seule communauté mondiale et ont des obligations mutuelles qui transcendent les frontières nationales le cosmopolitisme fort exigeant une justice mondiale institutionnelle et le cosmopolitisme faible n'exigeant que des obligations humanitaires.
hint: He argued that the concept of cosmopolitanism in political philosophy holds that all human beings are members of a single global community and have obligations to each other that transcend national boundaries with strong cosmopolitanism requiring institutional global justice and weak cosmopolitanism requiring only humanitarian obligations.
answers: He argued that the concept of cosmopolitanism in political philosophy holds that all human beings are members of a single global community and have obligations to each other that transcend national boundaries with strong cosmopolitanism requiring institutional global justice and weak cosmopolitanism requiring only humanitarian obligations.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de justice distributive mondiale examine si les principes de justice qui s'appliquent au sein des États devraient s'étendre à l'échelle mondiale les comptes cosmopolites plaidant pour des principes mondiaux de distribution et les comptes étatistes soutenant que les principes de justice distributive ne s'appliquent qu'au sein des communautés politiques qui partagent des institutions coercitives.
hint: She contended that the concept of global distributive justice examines whether principles of justice that apply within states should extend globally with cosmopolitan accounts arguing for global principles of distribution and statist accounts arguing that distributive justice principles apply only within political communities that share coercive institutions.
answers: She contended that the concept of global distributive justice examines whether principles of justice that apply within states should extend globally with cosmopolitan accounts arguing for global principles of distribution and statist accounts arguing that distributive justice principles apply only within political communities that share coercive institutions.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'intervention humanitaire soulève des questions sur quand si jamais les États sont justifiés d'utiliser la force militaire dans d'autres États pour prévenir des atrocités massives et si la doctrine de la responsabilité de protéger R2P a créé des normes internationales exécutoires pouvant remplacer la souveraineté de l'État.
hint: He maintained that the concept of humanitarian intervention raises questions about when if ever states are justified in using military force in other states to prevent mass atrocities and whether the doctrine of the responsibility to protect R2P has created enforceable international norms that can override state sovereignty.
answers: He maintained that the concept of humanitarian intervention raises questions about when if ever states are justified in using military force in other states to prevent mass atrocities and whether the doctrine of the responsibility to protect R2P has created enforceable international norms that can override state sovereignty.

en: Elle a soutenu que la théorie de la guerre juste développée d'Aquin à travers Grotius jusqu'à Walzer examine les conditions dans lesquelles l'initiation d'une guerre peut être juste exigeant une cause juste une intention juste une autorité appropriée un dernier recours la proportionnalité et une chance raisonnable de succès et quelle conduite dans la guerre est permissible selon les principes de discrimination et de proportionnalité.
hint: She argued that just war theory as developed from Aquinas through Grotius to Walzer examines the conditions under which initiating war can be just requiring just cause right intention proper authority last resort proportionality and reasonable chance of success and what conduct in war is permissible under principles of discrimination and proportionality.
