answers: She argued that the concept of civil society in political philosophy refers to the sphere of voluntary associations and non-governmental organisations between the family and the state that provides space for collective action the articulation of interests and values and the formation of political identities outside the direct control of the state.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de capital social développé par Putnam désigne les réseaux d'engagement civique la confiance et les normes de réciprocité qui facilitent l'action collective et que le déclin du capital social dans les démocraties contemporaines par l'individualisation et la réduction de la participation civique menace la gouvernance démocratique.
hint: He contended that the concept of social capital as developed by Putnam refers to the networks of civic engagement trust and norms of reciprocity that facilitate collective action and that the decline of social capital in contemporary democracies through individualisation and reduced civic participation threatens democratic governance.
answers: He contended that the concept of social capital as developed by Putnam refers to the networks of civic engagement trust and norms of reciprocity that facilitate collective action and that the decline of social capital in contemporary democracies through individualisation and reduced civic participation threatens democratic governance.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de légitimité en philosophie politique désigne le droit de gouverner qui découle non pas seulement de l'efficacité ou de la force mais de fondements normatifs tels que le consentement la souveraineté populaire la responsabilité démocratique la justice ou la conformité constitutionnelle et que les gouvernements illégitimes font face à des défis moraux et politiques distinctifs.
hint: She maintained that the concept of legitimacy in political philosophy refers to the right to rule that derives not merely from effectiveness or force but from normative grounds such as consent popular sovereignty democratic accountability justice or constitutional compliance and that illegitimate governments face distinctive moral and political challenges.
answers: She maintained that the concept of legitimacy in political philosophy refers to the right to rule that derives not merely from effectiveness or force but from normative grounds such as consent popular sovereignty democratic accountability justice or constitutional compliance and that illegitimate governments face distinctive moral and political challenges.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de souveraineté a été remis en cause par la mondialisation les institutions supranationales le droit international des droits de l'homme et la gouvernance environnementale mondiale soulevant des questions sur si la souveraineté peut être mise en commun déléguée ou bornée par des normes internationales sans miner la détermination démocratique des communautés politiques.
hint: He argued that the concept of sovereignty has been challenged by globalisation supranational institutions international human rights law and global environmental governance raising questions about whether sovereignty can be pooled delegated or bounded by international norms without undermining the democratic self-determination of political communities.
answers: He argued that the concept of sovereignty has been challenged by globalisation supranational institutions international human rights law and global environmental governance raising questions about whether sovereignty can be pooled delegated or bounded by international norms without undermining the democratic self-determination of political communities.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de républicanisme comme philosophie politique soutient que la liberté ne consiste pas seulement en la non-interférence comme les libéraux le soutiennent mais en la non-domination dans le fait de ne pas être soumis à la volonté arbitraire d'une autre personne ou institution et que les institutions républicaines et la vertu civique sont nécessaires pour maintenir la non-domination.
hint: She contended that the concept of republicanism as a political philosophy holds that freedom consists not merely in non-interference as liberals argue but in non-domination in not being subject to the arbitrary will of another person or institution and that republican institutions and civic virtue are necessary to sustain non-domination.
answers: She contended that the concept of republicanism as a political philosophy holds that freedom consists not merely in non-interference as liberals argue but in non-domination in not being subject to the arbitrary will of another person or institution and that republican institutions and civic virtue are necessary to sustain non-domination.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de fédéralisme en philosophie politique examine comment la souveraineté est divisée entre les autorités centrales et régionales quels principes devraient guider l'allocation des pouvoirs entre les niveaux de gouvernement et comment les arrangements fédéraux peuvent accommoder la diversité maintenir l'unité et protéger les communautés minoritaires de la domination majoritaire.
hint: He argued that the concept of federalism in political philosophy examines how sovereignty is divided between central and regional authorities what principles should guide the allocation of powers between levels of government and how federal arrangements can accommodate diversity maintain unity and protect minority communities from majority domination.
answers: He argued that the concept of federalism in political philosophy examines how sovereignty is divided between central and regional authorities what principles should guide the allocation of powers between levels of government and how federal arrangements can accommodate diversity maintain unity and protect minority communities from majority domination.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de démocratie délibérative soutient que la légitimité démocratique exige non seulement d'agréger les préférences par le vote mais de les transformer par un processus de délibération publique dans lequel les citoyens échangent des raisons justifient des positions et sont ouverts à la persuasion rationnelle conduisant à des décisions plus éclairées et publiquement justifiées.
hint: She maintained that the concept of deliberative democracy holds that democratic legitimacy requires not merely aggregating preferences through voting but transforming them through a process of public deliberation in which citizens exchange reasons justify positions and are open to rational persuasion leading to more informed and publicly justified decisions.
answers: She maintained that the concept of deliberative democracy holds that democratic legitimacy requires not merely aggregating preferences through voting but transforming them through a process of public deliberation in which citizens exchange reasons justify positions and are open to rational persuasion leading to more informed and publicly justified decisions.

en: Il a soutenu que la démocratie agonistique développée par Mouffe critique la démocratie délibérative pour ignorer le rôle constitutif du conflit et de l'antagonisme dans la politique et soutient que la politique démocratique devrait transformer l'antagonisme entre ennemis en agonisme entre adversaires qui partagent un espace symbolique commun mais contestent les interprétations hégémoniques des valeurs démocratiques.
hint: He contended that agonistic democracy as developed by Mouffe criticises deliberative democracy for ignoring the constitutive role of conflict and antagonism in politics and argues that democratic politics should transform antagonism between enemies into agonism between adversaries who share a common symbolic space but contest hegemonic interpretations of democratic values.
answers: He contended that agonistic democracy as developed by Mouffe criticises deliberative democracy for ignoring the constitutive role of conflict and antagonism in politics and argues that democratic politics should transform antagonism between enemies into agonism between adversaries who share a common symbolic space but contest hegemonic interpretations of democratic values.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de recul démocratique examine le processus par lequel les systèmes démocratiques s'érodent par des étapes progressives qui individuellement peuvent sembler mineures mais qui cumulativement sapent les freins et contrepoids institutionnels l'intégrité électorale les libertés civiles et l'état de droit souvent par des dirigeants élus qui utilisent des moyens démocratiques pour subvertir la démocratie.
hint: She argued that the concept of democratic backsliding examines the process by which democratic systems erode through incremental steps that individually may seem minor but cumulatively undermine institutional checks and balances electoral integrity civil liberties and the rule of law often through elected leaders who use democratic means to subvert democracy.
answers: She argued that the concept of democratic backsliding examines the process by which democratic systems erode through incremental steps that individually may seem minor but cumulatively undermine institutional checks and balances electoral integrity civil liberties and the rule of law often through elected leaders who use democratic means to subvert democracy.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de polarisation politique examine la divergence croissante des attitudes et identités politiques entre les groupes la distinction entre la polarisation des enjeux et la polarisation affective le rôle des médias et des réseaux sociaux dans l'amplification de la polarisation et ses effets sur la délibération démocratique le compromis et la gouvernance.
hint: He maintained that the concept of political polarisation examines the increasing divergence of political attitudes and identities between groups the distinction between issue polarisation and affective polarisation the role of media and social networks in amplifying polarisation and its effects on democratic deliberation compromise and governance.
answers: He maintained that the concept of political polarisation examines the increasing divergence of political attitudes and identities between groups the distinction between issue polarisation and affective polarisation the role of media and social networks in amplifying polarisation and its effects on democratic deliberation compromise and governance.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de technocratie examine la légitimité de confier les décisions politiques aux experts et aux spécialistes techniques les critiques soutenant que la gouvernance technocratique sape la responsabilité démocratique et traite les questions politiques de valeur de distribution et de priorité comme si elles étaient de pures questions techniques n'admettant qu'une seule réponse correcte.
hint: She contended that the concept of technocracy examines the legitimacy of deferring political decisions to experts and technical specialists with critics arguing that technocratic governance undermines democratic accountability and treats political questions of value distribution and priority as if they were purely technical questions admitting of only one correct answer.
answers: She contended that the concept of technocracy examines the legitimacy of deferring political decisions to experts and technical specialists with critics arguing that technocratic governance undermines democratic accountability and treats political questions of value distribution and priority as if they were purely technical questions admitting of only one correct answer.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de néolibéralisme comme philosophie politico-économique mettant l'accent sur la concurrence marchande l'individualisation la dérégulation la privatisation et la réduction de l'État-providence a été analysé par Foucault comme une forme de gouvernementalité qui remodèle la subjectivité et par Harvey comme un projet de restauration du pouvoir de classe.
hint: He argued that the concept of neoliberalism as a political economic philosophy emphasising market competition individualisation deregulation privatisation and the reduction of the welfare state has been analysed by Foucault as a form of governmentality that reshapes subjectivity and by Harvey as a project of class power restoration.
answers: He argued that the concept of neoliberalism as a political economic philosophy emphasising market competition individualisation deregulation privatisation and the reduction of the welfare state has been analysed by Foucault as a form of governmentality that reshapes subjectivity and by Harvey as a project of class power restoration.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'austérité comme politique économique désigne la réduction des dépenses gouvernementales du déficit et de la dette et que ses implications philosophiques et politiques soulèvent des questions sur la distribution des coûts d'ajustement entre les groupes sociaux si les gouvernements font face à de véritables contraintes fiscales ou à des choix politiques et les preuves des effets macroéconomiques de l'austérité.
hint: She maintained that the concept of austerity as economic policy refers to the reduction of government expenditure deficit and debt and its philosophical and political implications raise questions about the distribution of adjustment costs between different social groups whether governments face genuine fiscal constraints or political choices and the evidence for austerity's macroeconomic effects.
answers: She maintained that the concept of austerity as economic policy refers to the reduction of government expenditure deficit and debt and its philosophical and political implications raise questions about the distribution of adjustment costs between different social groups whether governments face genuine fiscal constraints or political choices and the evidence for austerity's macroeconomic effects.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de revenu de base universel comme proposition de politique examine si des paiements inconditionnels à tous les citoyens réduiraient la pauvreté et les inégalités fourniraient une sécurité permettant la prise de risques et le travail créatif changeraient la relation de pouvoir entre employeurs et travailleurs et s'il est abordable et compatible avec des finances publiques durables.
hint: He contended that the concept of universal basic income as a policy proposal examines whether unconditional payments to all citizens would reduce poverty and inequality provide security enabling risk-taking and creative work change the power relationship between employers and workers and whether it is affordable and compatible with sustainable public finances.
answers: He contended that the concept of universal basic income as a policy proposal examines whether unconditional payments to all citizens would reduce poverty and inequality provide security enabling risk-taking and creative work change the power relationship between employers and workers and whether it is affordable and compatible with sustainable public finances.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de décroissance remet en cause l'hypothèse que la croissance économique mesurée par le PIB est une condition nécessaire au bien-être humain et à la durabilité environnementale soutenant que les sociétés riches doivent réduire leur consommation de ressources et d'énergie tout en maintenant ou améliorant le bien-être par la redistribution du revenu du travail et du temps.
hint: She argued that the concept of degrowth challenges the assumption that economic growth measured by GDP is a necessary condition for human welfare and environmental sustainability arguing that wealthy societies need to reduce their resource throughput and energy consumption while maintaining or improving wellbeing through redistribution of income work and time.
answers: She argued that the concept of degrowth challenges the assumption that economic growth measured by GDP is a necessary condition for human welfare and environmental sustainability arguing that wealthy societies need to reduce their resource throughput and energy consumption while maintaining or improving wellbeing through redistribution of income work and time.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'économie de plateforme ou d'économie à la tâche soulève des questions philosophiques sur la classification des travailleurs de plateforme comme employés ou travailleurs indépendants quelles obligations les plateformes ont envers les travailleurs si la gestion algorithmique constitue une forme de domination et comment étendre les protections du travail au travail précaire de plateforme.
hint: He maintained that the concept of platform economy or gig economy raises philosophical questions about the classification of platform workers as employees or independent contractors what obligations platforms owe workers whether algorithmic management constitutes a form of domination and how to extend labour protections to precarious platform work.
answers: He maintained that the concept of platform economy or gig economy raises philosophical questions about the classification of platform workers as employees or independent contractors what obligations platforms owe workers whether algorithmic management constitutes a form of domination and how to extend labour protections to precarious platform work.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de gouvernance algorithmique examine comment les algorithmes prennent ou informent de plus en plus les décisions sur les individus dans des domaines tels que le crédit l'emploi la justice pénale la santé et le bien-être et si les décisions algorithmiques peuvent être transparentes explicables responsables et équitables étant donné qu'elles peuvent encoder et amplifier les biais sociaux existants.
hint: She contended that the concept of algorithmic governance examines how algorithms increasingly make or inform decisions about individuals in areas such as credit employment criminal justice healthcare and welfare and whether algorithmic decisions can be transparent explainable accountable and fair given that they may encode and amplify existing social biases.
answers: She contended that the concept of algorithmic governance examines how algorithms increasingly make or inform decisions about individuals in areas such as credit employment criminal justice healthcare and welfare and whether algorithmic decisions can be transparent explainable accountable and fair given that they may encode and amplify existing social biases.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de capitalisme de surveillance développé par Zuboff désigne l'extraction de données personnelles comme matière première pour la prédiction et la modification du comportement humain à grande échelle soutenant que cela représente une nouvelle logique économique qui sape l'autonomie et la démocratie en transformant l'expérience humaine privée en marchandise.
hint: He argued that the concept of surveillance capitalism as developed by Zuboff refers to the extraction of personal data as a raw material for the prediction and modification of human behaviour at scale claiming that this represents a new economic logic that undermines autonomy and democracy by commodifying private human experience.
answers: He argued that the concept of surveillance capitalism as developed by Zuboff refers to the extraction of personal data as a raw material for the prediction and modification of human behaviour at scale claiming that this represents a new economic logic that undermines autonomy and democracy by commodifying private human experience.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la vie privée examine si la vie privée est un droit fondamental ce qui fonde la vie privée comme valeur si elle est fondée sur l'autonomie la dignité la propriété ou la liberté de la surveillance comment les intérêts de la vie privée devraient être équilibrés avec la sécurité la transparence la responsabilité et les biens épistémiques dans les sociétés démocratiques.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of privacy examines whether privacy is a fundamental right what grounds privacy as a value whether it is grounded in autonomy dignity property or freedom from surveillance how privacy interests should be balanced against security transparency accountability and epistemic goods in democratic societies.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of privacy examines whether privacy is a fundamental right what grounds privacy as a value whether it is grounded in autonomy dignity property or freedom from surveillance how privacy interests should be balanced against security transparency accountability and epistemic goods in democratic societies.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de liberté d'expression en philosophie politique soulève des questions sur ce qui fonde le droit à la liberté d'expression si elle est fondée sur l'autonomie la démocratie la recherche de la vérité ou l'utilité quelles en sont les limites et si le discours haineux la désinformation nuisible ou le discours qui fait taire les autres peut être légitimement restreint.
hint: He contended that the concept of free speech in political philosophy raises questions about what grounds the right to free speech whether it is grounded in autonomy democracy truth-seeking or utility what its limits are and whether hate speech harmful misinformation or speech that silences others can be legitimately restricted.
answers: He contended that the concept of free speech in political philosophy raises questions about what grounds the right to free speech whether it is grounded in autonomy democracy truth-seeking or utility what its limits are and whether hate speech harmful misinformation or speech that silences others can be legitimately restricted.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'injustice épistémique développé par Miranda Fricker identifie deux formes principales l'injustice testimoniale où un locuteur reçoit un déficit de crédibilité dû au préjugé et l'injustice herméneutique où des lacunes dans les ressources interprétatives collectives désavantagent quelqu'un lorsqu'il tente de donner sens à ses propres expériences.
hint: She argued that the concept of epistemic injustice as developed by Miranda Fricker identifies two main forms testimonial injustice where a speaker receives a credibility deficit due to prejudice and hermeneutical injustice where gaps in collective interpretive resources place someone at a disadvantage when trying to make sense of their own experiences.
answers: She argued that the concept of epistemic injustice as developed by Miranda Fricker identifies two main forms testimonial injustice where a speaker receives a credibility deficit due to prejudice and hermeneutical injustice where gaps in collective interpretive resources place someone at a disadvantage when trying to make sense of their own experiences.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de gaslighting en philosophie et en psychologie désigne une forme de manipulation psychologique dans laquelle une personne est amenée à remettre en question sa propre perception sa mémoire et son jugement et soulève des questions philosophiques plus larges sur les dimensions épistémiques et éthiques de la manipulation systématique de la compréhension de soi d'une autre personne.
hint: He maintained that the concept of gaslighting in philosophy and psychology refers to a form of psychological manipulation in which a person is made to question their own perception memory and judgment and raises broader philosophical questions about the epistemic and ethical dimensions of systematic manipulation of another person's self-understanding.
answers: He maintained that the concept of gaslighting in philosophy and psychology refers to a form of psychological manipulation in which a person is made to question their own perception memory and judgment and raises broader philosophical questions about the epistemic and ethical dimensions of systematic manipulation of another person's self-understanding.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de théorie du coup de pouce développé par Thaler et Sunstein soutient que le comportement peut être influencé vers des résultats bénéfiques en structurant les architectures de choix sans interdire les options ou utiliser des incitations économiques et soulève des questions philosophiques sur si les coups de pouce sont compatibles avec le respect de l'autonomie et de l'agentivité rationnelle ou représentent une manipulation paternaliste.
hint: She contended that the concept of nudge theory as developed by Thaler and Sunstein holds that behaviour can be influenced toward beneficial outcomes by structuring choice architectures without prohibiting options or using economic incentives and raises philosophical questions about whether nudges are compatible with respect for autonomy and rational agency or represent paternalistic manipulation.
answers: She contended that the concept of nudge theory as developed by Thaler and Sunstein holds that behaviour can be influenced toward beneficial outcomes by structuring choice architectures without prohibiting options or using economic incentives and raises philosophical questions about whether nudges are compatible with respect for autonomy and rational agency or represent paternalistic manipulation.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de paternalisme en philosophie politique désigne l'interférence avec l'autonomie d'une personne justifiée par un appel à son propre bien-être ou ses propres intérêts et que l'anti-paternalisme libéral suivant Mill soutient que les individus sont généralement les meilleurs juges de leurs propres intérêts et que l'intervention paternaliste nécessite une justification spéciale.
hint: He argued that the concept of paternalism in political philosophy refers to interference with a person's autonomy justified by appeal to their own welfare or interests and that liberal anti-paternalism following Mill holds that individuals are generally the best judges of their own interests and that paternalistic intervention requires special justification.
answers: He argued that the concept of paternalism in political philosophy refers to interference with a person's autonomy justified by appeal to their own welfare or interests and that liberal anti-paternalism following Mill holds that individuals are generally the best judges of their own interests and that paternalistic intervention requires special justification.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la psychiatrie examine les fondements conceptuels de la psychiatrie y compris ce qu'est le trouble mental et comment distinguer le trouble de la détresse le rôle des valeurs dans le diagnostic psychiatrique la validité des systèmes de classification psychiatrique et les implications des modèles explicatifs biologiques psychologiques et sociaux pour le traitement et la responsabilité morale.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of psychiatry examines the conceptual foundations of psychiatry including what mental disorder is and how to distinguish disorder from distress the role of values in psychiatric diagnosis the validity of psychiatric classification systems and the implications of biological psychological and social explanatory models for treatment and moral responsibility.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of psychiatry examines the conceptual foundations of psychiatry including what mental disorder is and how to distinguish disorder from distress the role of values in psychiatric diagnosis the validity of psychiatric classification systems and the implications of biological psychological and social explanatory models for treatment and moral responsibility.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de trouble mental analysé par Wakefield combine un compte de dysfonctionnement nuisible soutenant qu'une condition est un trouble lorsqu'elle implique l'échec d'un mécanisme biologique ou mental à fonctionner comme il a été conçu par la sélection naturelle et lorsque cet échec cause un préjudice dans le contexte social actuel.
hint: He contended that the concept of mental disorder as analysed by Wakefield combines a harmful dysfunction account holding that a condition is a disorder when it involves a failure of a biological or mental mechanism to function as it was designed by natural selection to function and when this failure causes harm in the current social context.
answers: He contended that the concept of mental disorder as analysed by Wakefield combines a harmful dysfunction account holding that a condition is a disorder when it involves a failure of a biological or mental mechanism to function as it was designed by natural selection to function and when this failure causes harm in the current social context.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de neurodiversité soutient que la variation neurologique telle que l'autisme le TDAH et la dyslexie devrait être reconnue comme une variation humaine naturelle plutôt que comme des troubles nécessitant une guérison et que des accommodements sociaux et environnementaux plutôt que la normalisation sont la réponse appropriée à la différence neurologique.
hint: She argued that the concept of neurodiversity holds that neurological variation such as autism ADHD and dyslexia should be recognised as natural human variation rather than as disorders requiring cure and that social and environmental accommodations rather than normalisation are the appropriate response to neurological difference.
answers: She argued that the concept of neurodiversity holds that neurological variation such as autism ADHD and dyslexia should be recognised as natural human variation rather than as disorders requiring cure and that social and environmental accommodations rather than normalisation are the appropriate response to neurological difference.

en: Il a soutenu que le modèle social du handicap développé dans les études sur le handicap soutient que le handicap n'est pas une propriété intrinsèque des individus mais est produit par des environnements sociaux conçus par et pour des personnes non handicapées et que la réponse appropriée au handicap est de supprimer les barrières sociales et environnementales plutôt que de guérir les individus.
hint: He maintained that the social model of disability as developed in disability studies holds that disability is not an intrinsic property of individuals but is produced by social environments that are designed for and by non-disabled people and that the appropriate response to disability is to remove social and environmental barriers rather than to cure individuals.
answers: He maintained that the social model of disability as developed in disability studies holds that disability is not an intrinsic property of individuals but is produced by social environments that are designed for and by non-disabled people and that the appropriate response to disability is to remove social and environmental barriers rather than to cure individuals.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de transhumanisme examine s'il est désirable d'utiliser la technologie pour améliorer les capacités cognitives émotionnelles et physiques humaines au-delà de leurs limites naturelles actuelles les partisans argumentant pour l'expansion de l'épanouissement humain et les critiques soulevant des préoccupations sur la justice l'accès les inégalités et la signification de l'expérience distinctement humaine.
hint: She contended that the concept of transhumanism examines whether it is desirable to use technology to enhance human cognitive emotional and physical capacities beyond their current natural limits with proponents arguing for the expansion of human flourishing and critics raising concerns about justice access inequality and the meaning of distinctively human experience.
answers: She contended that the concept of transhumanism examines whether it is desirable to use technology to enhance human cognitive emotional and physical capacities beyond their current natural limits with proponents arguing for the expansion of human flourishing and critics raising concerns about justice access inequality and the meaning of distinctively human experience.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de l'amélioration cognitive examine si les interventions améliorant l'attention la mémoire et la cognition par les médicaments la stimulation cérébrale ou la modification génétique sont catégoriquement différentes de l'éducation l'entraînement et la nutrition et si elles soulèvent des préoccupations distinctives sur l'authenticité l'avantage déloyal et la signification de la réussite cognitive.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of cognitive enhancement examines whether interventions that improve attention memory and cognition through pharmaceuticals brain stimulation or genetic modification are categorically different from education training and nutrition and whether they raise distinctive concerns about authenticity unfair advantage and the meaning of cognitive achievement.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of cognitive enhancement examines whether interventions that improve attention memory and cognition through pharmaceuticals brain stimulation or genetic modification are categorically different from education training and nutrition and whether they raise distinctive concerns about authenticity unfair advantage and the meaning of cognitive achievement.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'amélioration génétique soulève des questions philosophiques sur la distinction entre thérapie et amélioration si les futurs parents ont le devoir de donner aux enfants le meilleur départ possible par la sélection génétique si la sélection génétique menace la diversité et l'acceptation inconditionnelle des enfants et quels principes devraient régir l'édition de la lignée germinale.
hint: She maintained that the concept of genetic enhancement raises philosophical questions about the distinction between therapy and enhancement whether prospective parents have a duty to give children the best start in life by genetic selection whether genetic selection threatens diversity and the unconditional acceptance of children and what principles should govern germline editing.
answers: She maintained that the concept of genetic enhancement raises philosophical questions about the distinction between therapy and enhancement whether prospective parents have a duty to give children the best start in life by genetic selection whether genetic selection threatens diversity and the unconditional acceptance of children and what principles should govern germline editing.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de dignité humaine comme concept philosophique et juridique fonde de nombreux comptes des droits de l'homme et est interprété différemment selon les traditions les comptes kantiens liant la dignité à l'autonomie rationnelle et au statut les traditions catholiques du droit naturel la liant au statut spécial des personnes créées à l'image de Dieu et les comptes séculiers l'ancrant dans la capacité d'auto-paternité.
hint: He contended that the concept of human dignity as a philosophical and legal concept grounds many accounts of human rights and is interpreted differently across traditions with Kantian accounts linking dignity to rational autonomy and status Catholic natural law traditions linking it to the special status of persons created in the image of God and secular accounts rooting it in the capacity for self-authorship.
answers: He contended that the concept of human dignity as a philosophical and legal concept grounds many accounts of human rights and is interpreted differently across traditions with Kantian accounts linking dignity to rational autonomy and status Catholic natural law traditions linking it to the special status of persons created in the image of God and secular accounts rooting it in the capacity for self-authorship.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de droits de l'homme soulève des questions philosophiques sur leur fondement si ils sont naturels moraux ou politiques et sur leur universalité si ils s'appliquent à tous les êtres humains indépendamment de la culture et des arrangements politiques et leur justification indépendamment de doctrines religieuses et métaphysiques contestées.
hint: She argued that the concept of human rights raises philosophical questions about their foundation whether they are natural moral or political and about their universality whether they apply to all human beings regardless of culture and political arrangements and their justification independently of contested religious and metaphysical doctrines.
answers: She argued that the concept of human rights raises philosophical questions about their foundation whether they are natural moral or political and about their universality whether they apply to all human beings regardless of culture and political arrangements and their justification independently of contested religious and metaphysical doctrines.

en: Il a soutenu que le débat philosophique entre le naturalisme et le non-naturalisme en métaéthique concerne si les propriétés morales sont identiques ou réductibles aux propriétés naturelles ou si les propriétés morales sont une catégorie sui generis de faits ne pouvant pas être réduits au monde naturel sans résidu.
hint: He maintained that the philosophical debate between naturalism and non-naturalism in metaethics concerns whether moral properties are identical to or reducible to natural properties or whether moral properties are a sui generis category of facts that cannot be reduced to the natural world without residue.
answers: He maintained that the philosophical debate between naturalism and non-naturalism in metaethics concerns whether moral properties are identical to or reducible to natural properties or whether moral properties are a sui generis category of facts that cannot be reduced to the natural world without residue.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de constructivisme en métaéthique soutient que les vérités morales ne sont pas découvertes mais construites par des procédures idéales de raisonnement pratique ou d'accord dans des conditions idéalisées le constructivisme rawlsien soutenant que les principes de justice sont ceux sur lesquels les parties s'accorderaient dans la position originelle derrière le voile d'ignorance.
hint: She contended that the concept of constructivism in metaethics holds that moral truths are not discovered but constructed through ideal procedures of practical reasoning or agreement under idealised conditions with Rawlsian constructivism holding that principles of justice are those that parties would agree to in the original position behind the veil of ignorance.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'éthique de la population développé par Parfit examine ce qui rend un futur meilleur qu'un autre lorsque la taille de la population peut différer soulevant la conclusion répugnante qu'un monde avec des milliards de personnes à peine heureuses pourrait être meilleur qu'un monde avec moins de personnes très heureuses si le bien-être total est le critère.
hint: He contended that the concept of population ethics as developed by Parfit examines what makes one future better than another when the population size may differ raising the repugnant conclusion that a world with billions of barely happy people may be better than a world with fewer very happy people if total welfare is the criterion.
answers: He contended that the concept of population ethics as developed by Parfit examines what makes one future better than another when the population size may differ raising the repugnant conclusion that a world with billions of barely happy people may be better than a world with fewer very happy people if total welfare is the criterion.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la science-fiction comme genre examine comment la science-fiction réalise un étrangement cognitif qui permet aux lecteurs d'examiner leurs propres hypothèses et leur société d'une perspective défamiliarisante et si la science-fiction peut constituer de véritables expériences de pensée philosophiques comme Darko Suvin et Samuel Delany l'ont soutenu.
hint: She argued that the philosophy of science fiction as a genre examines how science fiction performs cognitive estrangement that enables readers to examine their own assumptions and society from a defamiliarising perspective and whether science fiction can constitute genuine philosophical thought experiments as Darko Suvin and Samuel Delany have argued.
answers: She argued that the philosophy of science fiction as a genre examines how science fiction performs cognitive estrangement that enables readers to examine their own assumptions and society from a defamiliarising perspective and whether science fiction can constitute genuine philosophical thought experiments as Darko Suvin and Samuel Delany have argued.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'expérience de pensée philosophique comme méthode examine si les scénarios hypothétiques peuvent révéler des vérités conceptuelles sur les situations réelles si les intuitions suscitées par les expériences de pensée sont des guides fiables vers la vérité philosophique et si les expériences de pensée sont sous-déterminées parce que nos intuitions peuvent être biaisées par des facteurs culturellement contingents.
hint: He maintained that the concept of the philosophical thought experiment as a method examines whether hypothetical scenarios can reveal conceptual truths about real situations whether intuitions elicited by thought experiments are reliable guides to philosophical truth and whether thought experiments are underdetermined because our intuitions may be biased by culturally contingent factors.
answers: He maintained that the concept of the philosophical thought experiment as a method examines whether hypothetical scenarios can reveal conceptual truths about real situations whether intuitions elicited by thought experiments are reliable guides to philosophical truth and whether thought experiments are underdetermined because our intuitions may be biased by culturally contingent factors.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de dilemme en éthique désigne les situations où un agent moral fait face à des obligations ou des valeurs concurrentes qui ne peuvent pas toutes être satisfaites et soulève des questions sur si les dilemmes moraux sont de véritables dilemmes où l'on a tort quoi qu'on fasse ou des dilemmes apparents qui se dissolvent sous une analyse plus soigneuse.
hint: She contended that the concept of dilemma in ethics refers to situations where a moral agent faces competing obligations or values that cannot all be satisfied and raises questions about whether moral dilemmas are genuine dilemmas where one is wrong whatever one does or apparent dilemmas that dissolve under more careful analysis.
answers: She contended that the concept of dilemma in ethics refers to situations where a moral agent faces competing obligations or values that cannot all be satisfied and raises questions about whether moral dilemmas are genuine dilemmas where one is wrong whatever one does or apparent dilemmas that dissolve under more careful analysis.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de tragédie morale examiné par Bernard Williams et Martha Nussbaum soutient que les véritables conflits moraux peuvent laisser un résidu moral même lorsque l'agent fait le meilleur choix disponible et que la reconnaissance de ce résidu sous forme de regret de remords ou d'une dette envers la partie lésée est moralement requise.
hint: He argued that the concept of moral tragedy as examined by Bernard Williams and Martha Nussbaum holds that genuine moral conflicts can leave moral residue even when the agent makes the best available choice and that acknowledgement of this residue in the form of regret remorse or a debt to the injured party is morally required.
answers: He argued that the concept of moral tragedy as examined by Bernard Williams and Martha Nussbaum holds that genuine moral conflicts can leave moral residue even when the agent makes the best available choice and that acknowledgement of this residue in the form of regret remorse or a debt to the injured party is morally required.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de psychologie morale examine les mécanismes psychologiques sous-jacents au jugement et au comportement moraux comment l'intuition et la raison interagissent dans le jugement moral si le caractère moral est une disposition stable à travers les situations et quelles sont les implications de la psychologie morale empirique pour l'éthique normative et la responsabilité morale.
hint: She maintained that the concept of moral psychology examines the psychological mechanisms underlying moral judgement and behaviour how intuition and reason interact in moral judgement whether moral character is a stable disposition across situations and what the implications of empirical moral psychology are for normative ethics and moral responsibility.
answers: She maintained that the concept of moral psychology examines the psychological mechanisms underlying moral judgement and behaviour how intuition and reason interact in moral judgement whether moral character is a stable disposition across situations and what the implications of empirical moral psychology are for normative ethics and moral responsibility.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'acquisition des vertus examine comment les vertus comme traits de caractère dispositions à percevoir ressentir et agir de manière appropriée dans les situations pertinentes sont acquises par l'habitude la pratique et la cultivation de la sagesse pratique phronesis et si le caractère peut être cultivé sans conditions et institutions sociales appropriées.
hint: He contended that the concept of virtue acquisition examines how virtues as character traits dispositions to perceive feel and act appropriately in relevant situations are acquired through habituation practice and the cultivation of practical wisdom phronesis and whether character can be cultivated without appropriate social conditions and institutions.
answers: He contended that the concept of virtue acquisition examines how virtues as character traits dispositions to perceive feel and act appropriately in relevant situations are acquired through habituation practice and the cultivation of practical wisdom phronesis and whether character can be cultivated without appropriate social conditions and institutions.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de chance morale tel qu'il se pose dans les cas de chance résultante remet en cause la vue kantienne selon laquelle l'évaluation morale authentique d'une personne ne peut concerner que ce qui est sous son contrôle puisque nous jugeons en fait les gens moralement pour ce qu'ils font et ce qui se passe à la suite de ce qu'ils font même lorsque les résultats dépendent de facteurs hors de leur contrôle.
hint: She argued that the concept of moral luck as it arises in cases of resultant luck challenges the Kantian view that genuine moral assessment of a person can only concern what is within their control since we in fact judge people morally for what they do and what happens as a result of what they do even when outcomes depend on factors beyond their control.
answers: She argued that the concept of moral luck as it arises in cases of resultant luck challenges the Kantian view that genuine moral assessment of a person can only concern what is within their control since we in fact judge people morally for what they do and what happens as a result of what they do even when outcomes depend on factors beyond their control.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la musique examine ce qu'est la musique comme forme d'art comment les œuvres musicales se rapportent aux performances aux partitions et aux traditions si la musique a une signification et si oui laquelle et comment les réponses émotionnelles à la musique sont possibles étant donné que la musique n'est pas littéralement triste ou joyeuse mais produit des réponses affectives chez les auditeurs.
hint: He maintained that the philosophy of music examines what music is as an art form how musical works relate to performances scores and traditions whether music has meaning and if so what kind and how emotional responses to music are possible given that music is not literally sad or joyful but produces affective responses in listeners.
answers: He maintained that the philosophy of music examines what music is as an art form how musical works relate to performances scores and traditions whether music has meaning and if so what kind and how emotional responses to music are possible given that music is not literally sad or joyful but produces affective responses in listeners.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de l'architecture examine si les bâtiments peuvent être beaux d'une manière distinctivement architecturale qui va au-delà de la simple apparence visuelle comment l'architecture crée et façonne l'expérience humaine quelles obligations les architectes ont envers les utilisateurs et les communautés ainsi qu'envers l'excellence esthétique et s'il existe une politique de l'espace enchâssée dans la conception architecturale.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of architecture examines whether buildings can be beautiful in a distinctively architectural way that goes beyond mere visual appearance how architecture creates and shapes human experience what obligations architects have to users and communities as well as to aesthetic excellence and whether there is a politics of space embedded in architectural design.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of architecture examines whether buildings can be beautiful in a distinctively architectural way that goes beyond mere visual appearance how architecture creates and shapes human experience what obligations architects have to users and communities as well as to aesthetic excellence and whether there is a politics of space embedded in architectural design.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du design examine si les objets de design peuvent être des objets esthétiques comme des œuvres d'art si le bon design exige à la fois l'excellence fonctionnelle et la qualité esthétique et si le design est fondamentalement une pratique de service orientée vers les utilisateurs ou une pratique artistique orientée vers les valeurs intrinsèques de l'objet conçu.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of design examines whether design objects can be aesthetic objects like works of art whether good design requires both functional excellence and aesthetic quality and whether design is fundamentally a service practice oriented to users or an artistic practice oriented to intrinsic values of the designed object.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of design examines whether design objects can be aesthetic objects like works of art whether good design requires both functional excellence and aesthetic quality and whether design is fundamentally a service practice oriented to users or an artistic practice oriented to intrinsic values of the designed object.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de l'artisanat examine ce qui distingue l'artisanat à la fois de l'art et de la production industrielle si le travail artisanal a une relation distinctive avec le moi du créateur si la virtuosité dans l'artisanat exige la compréhension plutôt que la simple technique et si les traditions artisanales peuvent être maintenues dans des conditions de reproduction industrielle et de fabrication numérique.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of craft examines what distinguishes craft from both art and industrial production whether craft work has a distinctive relationship to the maker's self whether virtuosity in craft requires understanding rather than mere technique and whether craft traditions can be maintained in conditions of industrial reproduction and digital fabrication.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of craft examines what distinguishes craft from both art and industrial production whether craft work has a distinctive relationship to the maker's self whether virtuosity in craft requires understanding rather than mere technique and whether craft traditions can be maintained in conditions of industrial reproduction and digital fabrication.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la photographie examine ce qui est distinctif de la représentation photographique si les photographies sont des documents de la réalité ou des images construites quelle est la relation entre la photographie et la vérité et quelles obligations éthiques les photographes ont lorsqu'ils représentent des sujets ou des communautés vulnérables.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of photography examines what is distinctive about photographic representation whether photographs are documents of reality or constructed images what the relationship between photography and truth is and what ethical obligations photographers have when representing vulnerable subjects or communities.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of photography examines what is distinctive about photographic representation whether photographs are documents of reality or constructed images what the relationship between photography and truth is and what ethical obligations photographers have when representing vulnerable subjects or communities.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'inquiétant étrange postcolonial examine comment les histoires coloniales hantent la vie culturelle et politique contemporaine comment les histoires coloniales supprimées reviennent sous une forme déguisée dans la littérature le cinéma et la politique contemporains et quelles obligations éthiques de mémoire et de réparation les sociétés avec des passés coloniaux ont envers les peuples anciennement colonisés.
hint: She argued that the concept of the postcolonial uncanny examines how colonial histories haunt contemporary cultural and political life how suppressed colonial histories return in disguised form in contemporary literature film and politics and what ethical obligations of memory and reparation societies with colonial pasts have toward formerly colonised peoples.
answers: She argued that the concept of the postcolonial uncanny examines how colonial histories haunt contemporary cultural and political life how suppressed colonial histories return in disguised form in contemporary literature film and politics and what ethical obligations of memory and reparation societies with colonial pasts have toward formerly colonised peoples.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de féminisme transnational examine les différentes conditions de la vie des femmes à l'échelle mondiale critique le féminisme universaliste occidental pour avoir imposé des conceptions culturellement spécifiques de la libération des femmes aux femmes non-occidentales et soutient qu'un féminisme véritablement inclusif doit prendre en compte les intersections du genre avec la race la classe le colonialisme et la culture.
hint: He maintained that the concept of transnational feminism examines the different conditions of women's lives globally critiques Western feminist universalism for imposing culturally specific conceptions of women's liberation on non-Western women and argues that a genuinely inclusive feminism must attend to the intersections of gender with race class colonialism and culture.
answers: He maintained that the concept of transnational feminism examines the different conditions of women's lives globally critiques Western feminist universalism for imposing culturally specific conceptions of women's liberation on non-Western women and argues that a genuinely inclusive feminism must attend to the intersections of gender with race class colonialism and culture.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de l'autonomie et de la dépendance examine le paradoxe que l'idéal d'agentivité rationnelle autonome célébré dans la philosophie politique libérale exige une infrastructure sociale extensive des soins et un soutien des autres et que l'image de l'individu autosuffisant et indépendant dissimule la dépendance constitutive de toutes les personnes envers les réseaux de soins et de soutien.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of autonomy and dependence examines the paradox that the ideal of autonomous rational agency celebrated in liberal political philosophy requires extensive social infrastructure care and support from others and that the image of the self-sufficient independent individual conceals the constitutive dependence of all persons on networks of care and support.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of autonomy and dependence examines the paradox that the ideal of autonomous rational agency celebrated in liberal political philosophy requires extensive social infrastructure care and support from others and that the image of the self-sufficient independent individual conceals the constitutive dependence of all persons on networks of care and support.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la reconnaissance développée par Hegel Honneth et Fraser examine comment la reconnaissance adéquate des personnes par les autres est une condition pour le développement d'une identité pratique positive et comment la méconnaissance par le mépris de l'intégrité physique de base l'exclusion des droits ou le déni de l'estime sociale constitue un préjudice envers les personnes qui génère des luttes pour la reconnaissance.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of recognition as developed by Hegel Honneth and Fraser examines how adequate recognition of persons by others is a condition for the development of a positive practical identity and how misrecognition through contempt for basic physical integrity exclusion from rights or denial of social esteem constitutes a harm to persons that generates struggles for recognition.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of recognition as developed by Hegel Honneth and Fraser examines how adequate recognition of persons by others is a condition for the development of a positive practical identity and how misrecognition through contempt for basic physical integrity exclusion from rights or denial of social esteem constitutes a harm to persons that generates struggles for recognition.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de solidarité comme valeur politique et morale examine ce que la solidarité exige si c'est une émotion une attitude un engagement ou une pratique comment la solidarité se rapporte à la justice si elle la complète ou entre en compétition avec elle et ce qui distingue la solidarité authentique de la charité la pitié ou la condescendance.
hint: She maintained that the concept of solidarity as a political and moral value examines what solidarity requires whether it is an emotion an attitude a commitment or a practice how solidarity relates to justice whether it supplements or competes with justice and what distinguishes genuine solidarity from charity pity or condescension.
answers: She maintained that the concept of solidarity as a political and moral value examines what solidarity requires whether it is an emotion an attitude a commitment or a practice how solidarity relates to justice whether it supplements or competes with justice and what distinguishes genuine solidarity from charity pity or condescension.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'économie politique de la connaissance examine comment la production la distribution et la propriété de la connaissance sont façonnées par les intérêts économiques comment les régimes de propriété intellectuelle affectent l'innovation et l'accès comment la connaissance académique est produite et à qui elle sert et s'il existe un déficit démocratique dans la gouvernance de la production des connaissances.
hint: He contended that the concept of political economy of knowledge examines how the production distribution and ownership of knowledge is shaped by economic interests how intellectual property regimes affect innovation and access how academic knowledge is produced and whose interests it serves and whether there is a democratic deficit in the governance of knowledge production.
answers: He contended that the concept of political economy of knowledge examines how the production distribution and ownership of knowledge is shaped by economic interests how intellectual property regimes affect innovation and access how academic knowledge is produced and whose interests it serves and whether there is a democratic deficit in the governance of knowledge production.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de réflexivité en théorie sociale examine comment les chercheurs sociaux affectent inévitablement et sont affectés par les phénomènes sociaux qu'ils étudient et quelles implications méthodologiques découlent de cette réflexivité y compris si l'objectivité en sciences sociales est atteignable et si la connaissance scientifique sociale sert inévitablement des intérêts politiques particuliers.
hint: She argued that the concept of reflexivity in social theory examines how social researchers inevitably affect and are affected by the social phenomena they study and what methodological implications follow from this reflexivity including whether objectivity in social science is attainable and whether social scientific knowledge inevitably serves particular political interests.
answers: She argued that the concept of reflexivity in social theory examines how social researchers inevitably affect and are affected by the social phenomena they study and what methodological implications follow from this reflexivity including whether objectivity in social science is attainable and whether social scientific knowledge inevitably serves particular political interests.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de naturalisme philosophique soutient que la philosophie devrait être continue avec la science naturelle et que les revendications véritablement philosophiques doivent être répondantes aux preuves empiriques tandis que les anti-naturalistes soutiennent que les questions philosophiques sur la signification la normativité et la conscience nécessitent des méthodes distinctivement philosophiques qui ne peuvent pas être réduites à la science naturelle.
hint: He maintained that the concept of philosophical naturalism holds that philosophy should be continuous with natural science and that genuinely philosophical claims must be answerable to empirical evidence while anti-naturalists argue that philosophical questions about meaning normativity and consciousness require distinctively philosophical methods that cannot be reduced to natural science.
answers: He maintained that the concept of philosophical naturalism holds that philosophy should be continuous with natural science and that genuinely philosophical claims must be answerable to empirical evidence while anti-naturalists argue that philosophical questions about meaning normativity and consciousness require distinctively philosophical methods that cannot be reduced to natural science.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de philosophie spéculative examine si le raisonnement philosophique peut légitimement aller au-delà des limites de l'expérience possible pour faire des revendications sur la nature de la réalité ultime et si la philosophie critique de Kant établit avec succès ces limites ou si la philosophie spéculative post-kantienne étend légitimement l'enquête philosophique au-delà des limites critiques.
hint: She contended that the concept of speculative philosophy examines whether philosophical reasoning can legitimately go beyond the limits of possible experience to make claims about the nature of ultimate reality and whether Kant's critical philosophy successfully establishes these limits or whether post-Kantian speculative philosophy legitimately extends philosophical inquiry beyond the critical limits.
answers: She contended that the concept of speculative philosophy examines whether philosophical reasoning can legitimately go beyond the limits of possible experience to make claims about the nature of ultimate reality and whether Kant's critical philosophy successfully establishes these limits or whether post-Kantian speculative philosophy legitimately extends philosophical inquiry beyond the critical limits.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la conscience examine ce qu'est la conscience comment elle se rapporte au cerveau et au monde physique si la conscience pourrait exister sans réalisation physique si l'introspection est une méthode fiable pour étudier la conscience et quelle est la différence entre la conscience phénoménale le ce-que-c'est-que-de et la conscience d'accès les informations disponibles pour le raisonnement et le rapport.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of consciousness examines what consciousness is how it relates to the brain and physical world whether consciousness could exist without physical realisation whether introspection is a reliable method for studying consciousness and what the difference is between phenomenal consciousness the what-it-is-like and access consciousness the information available for reasoning and report.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of consciousness examines what consciousness is how it relates to the brain and physical world whether consciousness could exist without physical realisation whether introspection is a reliable method for studying consciousness and what the difference is between phenomenal consciousness the what-it-is-like and access consciousness the information available for reasoning and report.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de qualia invoqué dans la philosophie de l'esprit désigne le caractère phénoménal intrinsèque de l'expérience consciente la rougeur du rouge la douleur de la douleur et soulève l'argument de la connaissance par la chambre de Mary montrant que la connaissance physique complète n'implique pas la connaissance de ce que c'est que d'avoir une expérience.
hint: She maintained that the concept of qualia as invoked in the philosophy of mind refers to the intrinsic phenomenal character of conscious experience the redness of red the painfulness of pain and raises the knowledge argument through Mary's room showing that complete physical knowledge does not entail knowledge of what it's like to have an experience.
answers: She maintained that the concept of qualia as invoked in the philosophy of mind refers to the intrinsic phenomenal character of conscious experience the redness of red the painfulness of pain and raises the knowledge argument through Mary's room showing that complete physical knowledge does not entail knowledge of what it's like to have an experience.

en: Il a soutenu que l'argument du zombie dans la philosophie de l'esprit soutient qu'il est concevable qu'il pourrait y avoir des êtres physiquement identiques aux humains mais dépourvus de toute conscience phénoménale montrant que la conscience phénoménale n'est pas impliquée par le physique et que le physicalisme sur l'esprit ne peut pas être toute la vérité.
hint: He contended that the zombie argument in philosophy of mind holds that it is conceivable that there could be beings physically identical to humans but lacking any phenomenal consciousness showing that phenomenal consciousness is not entailed by the physical and that physicalism about the mind cannot be the whole truth.
answers: He contended that the zombie argument in philosophy of mind holds that it is conceivable that there could be beings physically identical to humans but lacking any phenomenal consciousness showing that phenomenal consciousness is not entailed by the physical and that physicalism about the mind cannot be the whole truth.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de panpsychisme comme position en philosophie de l'esprit soutient que la conscience ou les propriétés proto-conscientes sont fondamentales et omniprésentes dans la nature et que les combiner par une relation de combinaison peut expliquer l'émergence de la conscience humaine complexe sans le fossé explicatif auquel font face les comptes physicalistes.
hint: She argued that the concept of panpsychism as a position in philosophy of mind holds that consciousness or proto-conscious properties are fundamental and ubiquitous in nature and that combining them through a combination relation can explain the emergence of complex human consciousness without the explanatory gap that faces physicalist accounts.
answers: She argued that the concept of panpsychism as a position in philosophy of mind holds that consciousness or proto-conscious properties are fundamental and ubiquitous in nature and that combining them through a combination relation can explain the emergence of complex human consciousness without the explanatory gap that faces physicalist accounts.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de conscience comme phénomène biologique défendu par Searle soutient que la conscience est causée par des processus cérébraux de niveau inférieur et est réalisée dans le cerveau de la même façon que d'autres phénomènes biologiques sont réalisés dans des systèmes physiques sans être réductible à ou identique à ces processus.
hint: He maintained that the concept of consciousness as a biological phenomenon as defended by Searle holds that consciousness is caused by lower-level brain processes and is realised in the brain in the same way that other biological phenomena are realised in physical systems without being reducible to or identical with those processes.
answers: He maintained that the concept of consciousness as a biological phenomenon as defended by Searle holds that consciousness is caused by lower-level brain processes and is realised in the brain in the same way that other biological phenomena are realised in physical systems without being reducible to or identical with those processes.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de principe d'énergie libre développé par Friston soutient que tous les systèmes biologiques auto-organisateurs y compris le cerveau agissent pour minimiser l'énergie libre comprise comme une borne sur la surprise et que la perception l'action et l'apprentissage peuvent tous être compris comme des processus d'inférence active qui minimisent l'erreur de prédiction.
hint: She contended that the concept of free energy principle as developed by Friston holds that all self-organising biological systems including the brain act to minimise free energy understood as a bound on surprise and that perception action and learning can all be understood as processes of active inference that minimise prediction error.
answers: She contended that the concept of free energy principle as developed by Friston holds that all self-organising biological systems including the brain act to minimise free energy understood as a bound on surprise and that perception action and learning can all be understood as processes of active inference that minimise prediction error.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de traitement prédictif ou codage prédictif développé par Helmholtz et plus récemment par Clark et Friston soutient que le cerveau est fondamentalement une machine à prédire qui génère des prédictions descendantes sur les entrées sensorielles et met continuellement à jour ces prédictions en fonction des erreurs de prédiction qui surviennent lorsque la réalité diffère des attentes.
hint: He argued that the concept of predictive processing or predictive coding as developed by Helmholtz and more recently by Clark and Friston holds that the brain is fundamentally a prediction machine that generates top-down predictions about sensory input and continuously updates these predictions based on prediction errors that arise when reality differs from expectation.
answers: He argued that the concept of predictive processing or predictive coding as developed by Helmholtz and more recently by Clark and Friston holds that the brain is fundamentally a prediction machine that generates top-down predictions about sensory input and continuously updates these predictions based on prediction errors that arise when reality differs from expectation.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie du langage examine la nature de la signification linguistique comment les phrases se rapportent au monde quelle est la relation entre la signification linguistique et la signification du locuteur et comment le contexte d'énonciation affecte l'interprétation la pragmatique examinant comment l'utilisation du langage en contexte va au-delà du contenu sémantique des phrases.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of language examines the nature of linguistic meaning how sentences relate to the world what the relationship between linguistic meaning and speaker meaning is and how context of utterance affects interpretation with pragmatics examining how language use in context goes beyond the semantic content of sentences.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of language examines the nature of linguistic meaning how sentences relate to the world what the relationship between linguistic meaning and speaker meaning is and how context of utterance affects interpretation with pragmatics examining how language use in context goes beyond the semantic content of sentences.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'holisme du sens développé par Quine et Davidson soutient que les significations des termes et des phrases individuels ne peuvent pas être déterminées en isolation mais seulement en relation avec l'ensemble du réseau de croyances et de pratiques linguistiques et que cet holisme a des implications radicales pour la possibilité de la traduction radicale et le relativisme du schème conceptuel.
hint: He contended that the concept of meaning holism as developed by Quine and Davidson holds that the meanings of individual terms and sentences cannot be determined in isolation but only in relation to the entire web of belief and linguistic practice and that this holism has radical implications for the possibility of radical translation and conceptual scheme relativism.
answers: He contended that the concept of meaning holism as developed by Quine and Davidson holds that the meanings of individual terms and sentences cannot be determined in isolation but only in relation to the entire web of belief and linguistic practice and that this holism has radical implications for the possibility of radical translation and conceptual scheme relativism.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de simulation incarnée développé en neurosciences cognitives et en philosophie soutient que la compréhension des actions des émotions et des états mentaux des autres implique la simulation de ces états dans ses propres systèmes sensori-moteurs et émotionnels plutôt que la formation de représentations théoriques détachées et que cela fonde l'empathie dans une résonance corporelle avec l'autre.
hint: She argued that the concept of embodied simulation as developed in cognitive neuroscience and philosophy holds that understanding others' actions emotions and mental states involves simulating those states in one's own sensorimotor and emotional systems rather than forming detached theoretical representations and that this grounds empathy in a bodily resonance with the other.
answers: She argued that the concept of embodied simulation as developed in cognitive neuroscience and philosophy holds that understanding others' actions emotions and mental states involves simulating those states in one's own sensorimotor and emotional systems rather than forming detached theoretical representations and that this grounds empathy in a bodily resonance with the other.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'enactivisme développé par Varela Thompson et Rosch soutient que l'esprit n'est pas dans la tête mais est constitué par le couplage de l'organisme avec son environnement et que la cognition n'est pas la représentation d'un monde pré-donné mais l'enactement d'un monde par l'activité d'un système vivant autonome.
hint: He maintained that the concept of enactivism as developed by Varela Thompson and Rosch holds that the mind is not in the head but is constituted by the coupling of the organism with its environment and that cognition is not the representation of a pre-given world but the enactment of a world through the activity of an autonomous living system.
answers: He maintained that the concept of enactivism as developed by Varela Thompson and Rosch holds that the mind is not in the head but is constituted by the coupling of the organism with its environment and that cognition is not the representation of a pre-given world but the enactment of a world through the activity of an autonomous living system.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de cognition situated soutient que les processus cognitifs sont fondamentalement façonnés par le contexte physique social et culturel dans lequel ils se produisent et que l'étude de la cognition dans des conditions de laboratoire isolées représente mal la nature de la cognition telle qu'elle se produit dans les environnements richement structurés de la vie quotidienne.
hint: She contended that the concept of situated cognition holds that cognitive processes are fundamentally shaped by the physical social and cultural context in which they occur and that studying cognition in isolated laboratory conditions misrepresents the nature of cognition as it occurs in the richly structured environments of everyday life.
answers: She contended that the concept of situated cognition holds that cognitive processes are fundamentally shaped by the physical social and cultural context in which they occur and that studying cognition in isolated laboratory conditions misrepresents the nature of cognition as it occurs in the richly structured environments of everyday life.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du témoignage examine dans quelles conditions les croyances formées sur la base du témoignage d'autres personnes constituent une connaissance si le témoignage est une source de base de croyance justifiée comparable à la perception et à la mémoire ou si il est réductible à l'inférence à partir de preuves sur la fiabilité du locuteur.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of testimony examines under what conditions beliefs formed on the basis of other people's testimony constitute knowledge whether testimony is a basic source of justified belief comparable to perception and memory or whether it is reducible to inference from evidence about the speaker's reliability.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of testimony examines under what conditions beliefs formed on the basis of other people's testimony constitute knowledge whether testimony is a basic source of justified belief comparable to perception and memory or whether it is reducible to inference from evidence about the speaker's reliability.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de vertu intellectuelle développé par Sosa Zagzebski et Greco soutient que la connaissance exige non seulement la croyance vraie produite de manière fiable mais la croyance vraie qui manifeste les vertus intellectuelles de l'agent cognitif telles que l'ouverture d'esprit le courage intellectuel et l'amour de la vérité et que l'épistémologie des vertus peut mieux expliquer la valeur de la connaissance par rapport à la simple croyance vraie.
hint: She maintained that the concept of intellectual virtue as developed by Sosa Zagzebski and Greco holds that knowledge requires not merely true belief that is produced reliably but true belief that manifests the cognitive agent's intellectual virtues such as open-mindedness intellectual courage and love of truth and that virtue epistemology can better explain the value of knowledge over mere true belief.
