answers: She maintained that the concept of intellectual virtue as developed by Sosa Zagzebski and Greco holds that knowledge requires not merely true belief that is produced reliably but true belief that manifests the cognitive agent's intellectual virtues such as open-mindedness intellectual courage and love of truth and that virtue epistemology can better explain the value of knowledge over mere true belief.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'anarchisme épistémologique développé par Feyerabend dans Contre la méthode soutient qu'il n'existe pas de méthode scientifique universelle qui ait gouverné l'histoire réelle du progrès scientifique et que le pluralisme méthodologique dans lequel toute méthode peut être utilisée si elle s'avère utile est l'approche la plus adéquate pour la croissance de la connaissance.
hint: He contended that the concept of epistemological anarchism as developed by Feyerabend in Against Method holds that there is no universal scientific method that has governed the actual history of scientific progress and that methodological pluralism in which any method may be used if it proves useful is the most adequate approach to the growth of knowledge.
answers: He contended that the concept of epistemological anarchism as developed by Feyerabend in Against Method holds that there is no universal scientific method that has governed the actual history of scientific progress and that methodological pluralism in which any method may be used if it proves useful is the most adequate approach to the growth of knowledge.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'objectivité scientifique examine ce que signifie pour l'enquête scientifique d'être objective si l'objectivité exige la liberté de tous les jugements de valeur ou seulement d'une classe restreinte de valeurs non-épistémiques comment l'objectivité peut être atteinte par des processus sociaux de contrôle critique et de réplication et si l'objectif d'une science sans valeurs est réalisable ou souhaitable.
hint: She argued that the concept of scientific objectivity examines what it means for scientific inquiry to be objective whether objectivity requires freedom from all value judgements or only a restricted class of non-epistemic values how objectivity can be achieved through social processes of critical scrutiny and replication and whether the goal of value-free science is achievable or desirable.
answers: She argued that the concept of scientific objectivity examines what it means for scientific inquiry to be objective whether objectivity requires freedom from all value judgements or only a restricted class of non-epistemic values how objectivity can be achieved through social processes of critical scrutiny and replication and whether the goal of value-free science is achievable or desirable.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de consensus scientifique examine ce qui constitue un véritable consensus scientifique comment le consensus devrait être communiqué au public et utilisé dans les débats politiques si le consensus est réalisable dans tous les domaines de l'enquête scientifique et quelle est la relation entre le consensus scientifique et la délibération démocratique sur les choix politiques.
hint: He maintained that the concept of scientific consensus examines what constitutes a genuine scientific consensus how consensus should be communicated to the public and used in policy debates whether consensus is achievable in all areas of scientific inquiry and what the relationship between scientific consensus and democratic deliberation about policy choices is.
answers: He maintained that the concept of scientific consensus examines what constitutes a genuine scientific consensus how consensus should be communicated to the public and used in policy debates whether consensus is achievable in all areas of scientific inquiry and what the relationship between scientific consensus and democratic deliberation about policy choices is.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de pseudo-science soulève des questions sur ce qui démarcation la science de la non-science si le critère de falsifiabilité proposé par Popper est un critère adéquat de démarcation et quels sont les préjudices sociaux et épistémiques des croyances pseudo-scientifiques et comment communiquer la différence entre science et pseudo-science au public.
hint: She contended that the concept of pseudo-science raises questions about what demarcates science from non-science whether the criterion of falsifiability proposed by Popper is an adequate criterion of demarcation and what the social and epistemic harms of pseudo-scientific beliefs are and how to communicate the difference between science and pseudo-science to the public.
answers: She contended that the concept of pseudo-science raises questions about what demarcates science from non-science whether the criterion of falsifiability proposed by Popper is an adequate criterion of demarcation and what the social and epistemic harms of pseudo-scientific beliefs are and how to communicate the difference between science and pseudo-science to the public.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de réalisme dépendant du modèle défendu par Hawking et Mlodinow soutient qu'il n'existe pas de concept de réalité indépendant du modèle et que les questions sur la nature ultime de la réalité n'ont aucun sens indépendamment des modèles ou des cadres théoriques utilisés pour les décrire et que différents modèles peuvent chacun être adéquats selon les phénomènes qu'ils décrivent.
hint: He argued that the concept of model-dependent realism as defended by Hawking and Mlodinow holds that there is no model-independent concept of reality and that questions about the ultimate nature of reality make no sense independently of the models or theoretical frameworks used to describe them and that different models may each be adequate depending on the phenomena they describe.
answers: He argued that the concept of model-dependent realism as defended by Hawking and Mlodinow holds that there is no model-independent concept of reality and that questions about the ultimate nature of reality make no sense independently of the models or theoretical frameworks used to describe them and that different models may each be adequate depending on the phenomena they describe.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la mécanique quantique examine si l'interprétation de Copenhague avec son effondrement de la fonction d'onde est la meilleure interprétation ou si les mondes multiples le Bohm pilote onde ou la mécanique quantique relationnelle fournissent de meilleurs comptes et quelles sont les implications métaphysiques de la mécanique quantique pour le déterminisme la localité et le réalisme.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of quantum mechanics examines whether the Copenhagen interpretation with its collapse of the wave function is the best interpretation or whether many-worlds Bohm pilot wave or relational quantum mechanics provide better accounts and what the metaphysical implications of quantum mechanics are for determinism locality and realism.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of quantum mechanics examines whether the Copenhagen interpretation with its collapse of the wave function is the best interpretation or whether many-worlds Bohm pilot wave or relational quantum mechanics provide better accounts and what the metaphysical implications of quantum mechanics are for determinism locality and realism.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de réalisme scientifique soutient que les entités inobservables postulées par les théories scientifiques réussies existent réellement et que nos meilleures théories sont approximativement vraies l'anti-réalisme dans ses diverses formes questionnant si le succès est une preuve de vérité plutôt que de simple adéquation empirique ou si les entités inobservables sont réelles.
hint: He contended that the concept of scientific realism holds that the unobservable entities postulated by successful scientific theories really exist and that our best theories are approximately true with anti-realism in its various forms questioning whether success is evidence of truth rather than merely empirical adequacy or whether unobservable entities are real.
answers: He contended that the concept of scientific realism holds that the unobservable entities postulated by successful scientific theories really exist and that our best theories are approximately true with anti-realism in its various forms questioning whether success is evidence of truth rather than merely empirical adequacy or whether unobservable entities are real.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'explication en philosophie des sciences examine ce qui fait quelque chose une véritable explication si les comptes causaux les comptes déductifs-nomologiques les comptes statistiques ou les comptes d'unification capturent le mieux la nature de l'explication scientifique et comment les explications se rapportent aux prédictions et à la compréhension.
hint: She argued that the concept of explanation in philosophy of science examines what makes something a genuine explanation whether causal accounts deductive-nomological accounts statistical accounts or unification accounts best capture the nature of scientific explanation and how explanations relate to predictions and understanding.
answers: She argued that the concept of explanation in philosophy of science examines what makes something a genuine explanation whether causal accounts deductive-nomological accounts statistical accounts or unification accounts best capture the nature of scientific explanation and how explanations relate to predictions and understanding.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de réduction en philosophie des sciences examine quand et si les théories et phénomènes de niveau supérieur peuvent être réduits aux théories et phénomènes de niveau inférieur si les sciences spéciales de la biologie de la psychologie et de la sociologie sont réductibles à la physique ou si elles sont des sciences autonomes avec leurs propres ressources explicatives irréductibles.
hint: He maintained that the concept of reduction in philosophy of science examines when and whether higher-level theories and phenomena can be reduced to lower-level ones whether the special sciences of biology psychology and sociology are reducible to physics or whether they are autonomous sciences with their own irreducible explanatory resources.
answers: He maintained that the concept of reduction in philosophy of science examines when and whether higher-level theories and phenomena can be reduced to lower-level ones whether the special sciences of biology psychology and sociology are reducible to physics or whether they are autonomous sciences with their own irreducible explanatory resources.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de sélection naturelle comme mécanisme du changement évolutif soulève des questions philosophiques sur ce que la sélection naturelle sélectionne gènes organismes traits groupes ou lignées ce qui constitue l'aptitude si l'aptitude est un concept circulaire et si la théorie de l'évolution fait des prédictions testables ou est compatible avec toute observation possible.
hint: She contended that the concept of natural selection as the mechanism of evolutionary change raises philosophical questions about what natural selection selects genes organisms traits groups or lineages what counts as fitness whether fitness is a circular concept and whether the theory of evolution makes testable predictions or is consistent with any possible observation.
answers: She contended that the concept of natural selection as the mechanism of evolutionary change raises philosophical questions about what natural selection selects genes organisms traits groups or lineages what counts as fitness whether fitness is a circular concept and whether the theory of evolution makes testable predictions or is consistent with any possible observation.

en: Il a soutenu que la synthèse évolutive étendue comme cadre émergent en biologie et en philosophie soutient que le néo-darwinisme standard ne rend pas compte de manière adéquate des phénomènes tels que la plasticité développementale la construction de niche l'héritage épigénétique et l'héritage culturel qui nécessitent d'étendre la théorie au-delà de la synthèse moderne standard de la génétique et de la sélection naturelle.
hint: He argued that the extended evolutionary synthesis as an emerging framework in biology and philosophy holds that standard neo-Darwinism inadequately accounts for phenomena such as developmental plasticity niche construction epigenetic inheritance and cultural inheritance that require extending the theory beyond the standard modern synthesis of genetics and natural selection.
answers: He argued that the extended evolutionary synthesis as an emerging framework in biology and philosophy holds that standard neo-Darwinism inadequately accounts for phenomena such as developmental plasticity niche construction epigenetic inheritance and cultural inheritance that require extending the theory beyond the standard modern synthesis of genetics and natural selection.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de sélection de groupe en biologie évolutive examine si la sélection naturelle peut opérer au niveau des groupes ainsi que des individus et si l'altruisme chez les animaux sociaux peut être expliqué par les avantages que le comportement altruiste confère aux individus apparentés partageant les gènes de l'altruiste dans ce que Hamilton a appelé l'aptitude inclusive.
hint: She maintained that the concept of group selection in evolutionary biology examines whether natural selection can operate at the level of groups as well as individuals and whether altruism in social animals can be explained by the benefits that altruistic behaviour confers on related individuals sharing the altruist's genes in what Hamilton called inclusive fitness.
answers: She maintained that the concept of group selection in evolutionary biology examines whether natural selection can operate at the level of groups as well as individuals and whether altruism in social animals can be explained by the benefits that altruistic behaviour confers on related individuals sharing the altruist's genes in what Hamilton called inclusive fitness.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la théorie de l'identité esprit-cerveau développée par Place Smart et Armstrong soutient que les états mentaux sont identiques aux états cérébraux et que cette identité est une découverte empirique comparable à la découverte que l'eau est H2O et que la distinctivité apparente des descriptions mentales par rapport aux descriptions physiques est seulement une question de signification et non d'ontologie.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of mind-brain identity theory as developed by Place Smart and Armstrong holds that mental states are identical to brain states and that this identity is an empirical discovery comparable to the discovery that water is H2O and that the apparent distinctiveness of mental descriptions from physical descriptions is merely a matter of meaning not ontology.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of mind-brain identity theory as developed by Place Smart and Armstrong holds that mental states are identical to brain states and that this identity is an empirical discovery comparable to the discovery that water is H2O and that the apparent distinctiveness of mental descriptions from physical descriptions is merely a matter of meaning not ontology.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de monisme anomal développé par Davidson soutient que les événements mentaux sont identiques aux événements physiques mais que les descriptions mentales et physiques des événements appartiennent à des schèmes conceptuels différents gouvernés par différentes contraintes de rationalité et qu'il n'existe pas de lois psychophysiques strictes reliant les descriptions mentales et physiques.
hint: She argued that the concept of anomalous monism as developed by Davidson holds that mental events are identical to physical events but that mental descriptions and physical descriptions of events belong to different conceptual schemes governed by different rationality constraints and that there are no strict psychophysical laws connecting mental and physical descriptions.
answers: She argued that the concept of anomalous monism as developed by Davidson holds that mental events are identical to physical events but that mental descriptions and physical descriptions of events belong to different conceptual schemes governed by different rationality constraints and that there are no strict psychophysical laws connecting mental and physical descriptions.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de désaccord entre pairs épistémiques examine ce que l'on devrait faire lorsque quelqu'un que l'on considère comme un égal épistémique est en désaccord avec sa croyance les vues résolues soutenant que l'on devrait maintenir sa croyance et les vues conciliantes soutenant que l'on devrait suspendre son jugement ou se déplacer vers une position de compromis.
hint: He maintained that the concept of epistemic peer disagreement examines what one should do when someone one regards as an epistemic equal disagrees with one's belief with steadfast views holding that one should maintain one's belief and conciliationist views holding that one should suspend judgement or move to a compromise position.
answers: He maintained that the concept of epistemic peer disagreement examines what one should do when someone one regards as an epistemic equal disagrees with one's belief with steadfast views holding that one should maintain one's belief and conciliationist views holding that one should suspend judgement or move to a compromise position.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de déférence morale examine s'il est jamais approprié de se déférer aux jugements moraux d'une autre personne plutôt que de former ses propres vues morales et si la déférence morale est analogue à la déférence épistémique au témoignage ou si former ses propres vues morales est constitutif de l'agentivité morale d'une manière qui ne peut pas être déléguée.
hint: She contended that the concept of moral deference examines whether it is ever appropriate to defer to another person's moral judgements rather than forming one's own moral views and whether moral deference is analogous to epistemic deference to testimony or whether forming one's own moral views is constitutive of moral agency in a way that cannot be delegated.
answers: She contended that the concept of moral deference examines whether it is ever appropriate to defer to another person's moral judgements rather than forming one's own moral views and whether moral deference is analogous to epistemic deference to testimony or whether forming one's own moral views is constitutive of moral agency in a way that cannot be delegated.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du genre examine ce qu'est le genre si le genre est une construction sociale un fait biologique ou une identité performée quelle est la relation entre le genre et le sexe biologique et comment les normes de genre contraignent et nuisent aux individus qui ne se conforment pas au binarisme de genre dominant tout en structurant également les possibilités de compréhension de soi humaine.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of gender examines what gender is whether gender is a social construction a biological fact or a performed identity what the relationship between gender and biological sex is and how gender norms constrain and harm individuals who fail to conform to the dominant gender binary while also structuring the possibilities for human self-understanding.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of gender examines what gender is whether gender is a social construction a biological fact or a performed identity what the relationship between gender and biological sex is and how gender norms constrain and harm individuals who fail to conform to the dominant gender binary while also structuring the possibilities for human self-understanding.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'hétéronormativité examine comment l'hétérosexualité est construite comme la forme naturelle normale et par défaut de la sexualité dans les institutions culturelles sociales et juridiques et comment cette construction marginalise les identités et pratiques non-hétérosexuelles et structure les possibilités de désir de reconnaissance et de vie intime disponibles pour les personnes LGBTQ+.
hint: She maintained that the concept of heteronormativity examines how heterosexuality is constructed as the natural normal and default form of sexuality in cultural social and legal institutions and how this construction marginalises non-heterosexual identities and practices and structures the possibilities for desire recognition and intimate life available to LGBTQ+ people.
answers: She maintained that the concept of heteronormativity examines how heterosexuality is constructed as the natural normal and default form of sexuality in cultural social and legal institutions and how this construction marginalises non-heterosexual identities and practices and structures the possibilities for desire recognition and intimate life available to LGBTQ+ people.

en: Il a soutenu que la théorie queer développée par Butler Sedgwick et d'autres examine comment les normes hétérosexuelles et de genre binaire sont produites et reproduites à travers les pratiques culturelles les discours régulateurs et la répétition performative et comment la mise en question de ces normes par des performances subversives de genre et de sexualité peut les perturber et potentiellement les transformer.
hint: He contended that queer theory as developed by Butler Sedgwick and others examines how heterosexual and binary gender norms are produced and reproduced through cultural practices regulatory discourses and performative repetition and how queering these norms through subversive performances of gender and sexuality can disrupt and potentially transform them.
answers: He contended that queer theory as developed by Butler Sedgwick and others examines how heterosexual and binary gender norms are produced and reproduced through cultural practices regulatory discourses and performative repetition and how queering these norms through subversive performances of gender and sexuality can disrupt and potentially transform them.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de reconnaissance de genre examine si les États devraient reconnaître légalement l'identité de genre indépendamment du sexe biologique par l'auto-identification quelles sont les implications de la reconnaissance de genre pour les espaces et institutions monosexes et quelles obligations de reconnaissance et de non-discrimination les identités de genre non-binaires et non-conformistes génèrent.
hint: She argued that the concept of gender recognition examines whether states should legally recognise gender identity independently of biological sex through self-identification what the implications of gender recognition for single-sex spaces and institutions are and what obligations of recognition and non-discrimination non-binary and non-conforming gender identities generate.
answers: She argued that the concept of gender recognition examines whether states should legally recognise gender identity independently of biological sex through self-identification what the implications of gender recognition for single-sex spaces and institutions are and what obligations of recognition and non-discrimination non-binary and non-conforming gender identities generate.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'épistémologie féministe examine comment le genre façonne la production de la connaissance dont la connaissance compte dans les communautés académiques et scientifiques si il existe des façons spécifiquement féministes de connaître et si l'épistémologie du point de vue a raison que les revendications de connaissance sont toujours situées depuis une position sociale particulière.
hint: He maintained that the concept of feminist epistemology examines how gender shapes the production of knowledge whose knowledge counts in academic and scientific communities whether there are specifically feminist ways of knowing and whether standpoint epistemology is right that knowledge claims are always situated from a particular social position.
answers: He maintained that the concept of feminist epistemology examines how gender shapes the production of knowledge whose knowledge counts in academic and scientific communities whether there are specifically feminist ways of knowing and whether standpoint epistemology is right that knowledge claims are always situated from a particular social position.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'objectification analysé par Nussbaum et d'autres identifie de multiples dimensions du traitement des personnes comme des objets y compris l'instrumentalité la fongibilité la violabilité la propriété et l'inertie et soulève des questions sur quand l'objectification est nuisible si des formes consenties d'objectification peuvent être acceptables et comment l'objectification se rapporte à l'exploitation et à la déshumanisation.
hint: She contended that the concept of objectification as analysed by Nussbaum and others identifies multiple dimensions of treating persons as objects including instrumentality fungibility violability ownership and inertness and raises questions about when objectification is harmful whether consensual forms of objectification can be acceptable and how objectification relates to exploitation and dehumanisation.
answers: She contended that the concept of objectification as analysed by Nussbaum and others identifies multiple dimensions of treating persons as objects including instrumentality fungibility violability ownership and inertness and raises questions about when objectification is harmful whether consensual forms of objectification can be acceptable and how objectification relates to exploitation and dehumanisation.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de féminisme du pouvoir versus féminisme de la victime comme débat au sein de la pensée féministe examine si la politique féministe devrait mettre l'accent sur la vulnérabilité et la victimisation des femmes par les structures patriarcales ou sur l'agentivité l'autonomisation et la capacité des femmes à résister à et transformer ces structures et quelles sont les implications politiques de chaque emphase.
hint: He argued that the concept of power feminism versus victim feminism as a debate within feminist thought examines whether feminist politics should emphasise women's vulnerability and victimhood by patriarchal structures or women's agency empowerment and capacity to resist and transform those structures and what the political implications of each emphasis are.
answers: He argued that the concept of power feminism versus victim feminism as a debate within feminist thought examines whether feminist politics should emphasise women's vulnerability and victimhood by patriarchal structures or women's agency empowerment and capacity to resist and transform those structures and what the political implications of each emphasis are.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de justice reproductive développé par des militants et des universitaires féministes noires examine les droits des femmes à avoir des enfants à ne pas avoir d'enfants et à être parents dans des environnements sûrs et favorables et étend le discours sur les droits reproductifs en reliant les choix reproductifs aux inégalités structurelles de race de classe et de statut d'immigration.
hint: She maintained that the concept of reproductive justice as developed by Black feminist activists and scholars examines the rights of women to have children not to have children and to parent in safe and supportive environments and extends reproductive rights discourse by connecting reproductive choices to structural inequalities of race class and immigration status.
answers: She maintained that the concept of reproductive justice as developed by Black feminist activists and scholars examines the rights of women to have children not to have children and to parent in safe and supportive environments and extends reproductive rights discourse by connecting reproductive choices to structural inequalities of race class and immigration status.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de philosophie du sport et de l'incarnation examine comment le corps est discipliné entraîné et transformé par la pratique athlétique comment la connaissance incarnée dans le sport diffère de la connaissance propositionnelle et si l'expérience de l'excellence athlétique fournit des insights sur la relation entre l'esprit le corps et la performance habile.
hint: He contended that the concept of the philosophy of sport and embodiment examines how the body is disciplined trained and transformed through athletic practice how embodied knowledge in sport differs from propositional knowledge and whether the experience of athletic excellence provides insight into the relationship between mind body and skilled performance.
answers: He contended that the concept of the philosophy of sport and embodiment examines how the body is disciplined trained and transformed through athletic practice how embodied knowledge in sport differs from propositional knowledge and whether the experience of athletic excellence provides insight into the relationship between mind body and skilled performance.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de médecine narrative examine comment la maladie et les soins de santé sont structurés par le récit et comment l'éducation médicale peut incorporer la compétence narrative dans la formation pour permettre aux prestataires de soins de santé d'assister aux histoires de maladie des patients comme des touts de comprendre le contexte particulier de la vie de chaque patient et de s'engager dans un témoignage empathique de la souffrance.
hint: She argued that the concept of narrative medicine examines how illness and healthcare are structured by narrative and how medical education can incorporate narrative competence into training to enable healthcare providers to attend to patients' illness stories as wholes understand the particular context of each patient's life and engage in empathic witnessing of suffering.
answers: She argued that the concept of narrative medicine examines how illness and healthcare are structured by narrative and how medical education can incorporate narrative competence into training to enable healthcare providers to attend to patients' illness stories as wholes understand the particular context of each patient's life and engage in empathic witnessing of suffering.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept d'épistémologie sociale examine comment les facteurs sociaux façonnent les pratiques et les résultats épistémiques des communautés si la division sociale du travail cognitif améliore ou entrave la croissance de la connaissance comment le témoignage la confiance et l'évaluation par les pairs fonctionnent comme des processus épistémiques sociaux et si les communautés épistémiques diverses ont de meilleurs résultats épistémiques que les communautés homogènes.
hint: He maintained that the concept of social epistemology examines how social factors shape the epistemic practices and outcomes of communities whether social division of cognitive labour enhances or impedes the growth of knowledge how testimony trust and peer review function as social epistemic processes and whether diverse epistemic communities have better epistemic outcomes than homogeneous ones.
answers: He maintained that the concept of social epistemology examines how social factors shape the epistemic practices and outcomes of communities whether social division of cognitive labour enhances or impedes the growth of knowledge how testimony trust and peer review function as social epistemic processes and whether diverse epistemic communities have better epistemic outcomes than homogeneous ones.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de démocratie épistémique examine si les procédures démocratiques ont une valeur épistémique pour produire des décisions correctes si le vote majoritaire la délibération ou les marchés agrègent mieux la connaissance dispersée comment protéger les minorités épistémiques de l'oppression épistémique majoritaire et si il existe un compromis entre la qualité épistémique et l'égalité politique dans la prise de décision démocratique.
hint: She contended that the concept of epistemic democracy examines whether democratic procedures are epistemically valuable for producing correct decisions whether majority voting deliberation or markets better aggregate dispersed knowledge how to protect epistemic minorities from majority epistemic oppression and whether there is a trade-off between epistemic quality and political equality in democratic decision-making.
answers: She contended that the concept of epistemic democracy examines whether democratic procedures are epistemically valuable for producing correct decisions whether majority voting deliberation or markets better aggregate dispersed knowledge how to protect epistemic minorities from majority epistemic oppression and whether there is a trade-off between epistemic quality and political equality in democratic decision-making.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du dialogue et de la différence développée par Bakhtine examine comment la véritable compréhension exige non pas l'absorption de la perspective de l'autre dans la sienne propre mais une rencontre dialogique qui préserve la différence irréductible de l'autre et que le discours monologique qui réduit toutes les perspectives à une seule voix faisant autorité appauvrit la compréhension.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of dialogue and difference as developed by Bakhtin examines how genuine understanding requires not the absorption of the other's perspective into one's own but a dialogic encounter that preserves the irreducible difference of the other and that monologic discourse which reduces all perspectives to a single authoritative voice impoverishes understanding.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of dialogue and difference as developed by Bakhtin examines how genuine understanding requires not the absorption of the other's perspective into one's own but a dialogic encounter that preserves the irreducible difference of the other and that monologic discourse which reduces all perspectives to a single authoritative voice impoverishes understanding.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de biocentrisme en éthique environnementale développé par Taylor soutient que tous les organismes vivants ont une valeur intrinsèque et des intérêts qui génèrent des obligations morales de non-interférence et que le bien de chaque organisme a le même poids moral prima facie que le bien de tout autre être vivant y compris les êtres humains.
hint: She maintained that the concept of biocentrism in environmental ethics as developed by Taylor holds that all living organisms have inherent worth and interests that generate moral obligations of non-interference and that the good of each organism has the same prima facie moral weight as the good of any other living being including human beings.
answers: She maintained that the concept of biocentrism in environmental ethics as developed by Taylor holds that all living organisms have inherent worth and interests that generate moral obligations of non-interference and that the good of each organism has the same prima facie moral weight as the good of any other living being including human beings.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de justice climatique examine qui supporte les coûts de la mitigation et de l'adaptation au changement climatique si les nations riches développées ont une plus grande obligation de réduire leurs émissions compte tenu de leurs contributions historiques aux gaz à effet de serre atmosphériques et quelle compensation le cas échéant est due aux nations les plus vulnérables aux impacts climatiques qu'elles n'ont pas causés.
hint: He contended that the concept of climate justice examines who bears the costs of climate change mitigation and adaptation whether wealthy developed nations have a greater obligation to reduce emissions given their historical contributions to atmospheric greenhouse gases and what compensation if any is owed to nations that are most vulnerable to climate impacts they did not cause.
answers: He contended that the concept of climate justice examines who bears the costs of climate change mitigation and adaptation whether wealthy developed nations have a greater obligation to reduce emissions given their historical contributions to atmospheric greenhouse gases and what compensation if any is owed to nations that are most vulnerable to climate impacts they did not cause.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de justice intergénérationnelle examine quelles obligations la génération actuelle a envers les générations futures si les personnes futures ont des droits pouvant fonder des revendications sur les générations présentes comment peser les intérêts des personnes existant actuellement par rapport aux intérêts des personnes futures qui n'existent pas encore et quels arrangements institutionnels peuvent représenter les intérêts des générations futures dans la prise de décision actuelle.
hint: She argued that the concept of intergenerational justice examines what obligations the present generation has to future generations whether future persons have rights that can ground claims on present generations how to weigh the interests of presently existing persons against the interests of not-yet-existing future persons and what institutional arrangements can represent future generations interests in present decision-making.
answers: She argued that the concept of intergenerational justice examines what obligations the present generation has to future generations whether future persons have rights that can ground claims on present generations how to weigh the interests of presently existing persons against the interests of not-yet-existing future persons and what institutional arrangements can represent future generations interests in present decision-making.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de communs analysé par Ostrom examine comment les communautés peuvent gouverner les ressources partagées de manière durable sans privatisation ni régulation étatique en développant des arrangements institutionnels locaux qui surveillent la conformité fournissent des sanctions graduées et permettent aux membres de la communauté de modifier les règles pour s'adapter aux circonstances locales.
hint: He maintained that the concept of the commons as analysed by Ostrom examines how communities can govern shared resources sustainably without either privatisation or state regulation by developing local institutional arrangements that monitor compliance provide graduated sanctions and allow community members to modify the rules to fit local circumstances.
answers: He maintained that the concept of the commons as analysed by Ostrom examines how communities can govern shared resources sustainably without either privatisation or state regulation by developing local institutional arrangements that monitor compliance provide graduated sanctions and allow community members to modify the rules to fit local circumstances.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'Anthropocène examine ce que la désignation d'une nouvelle ère géologique définie par l'impact humain sur la planète implique pour la philosophie l'éthique environnementale et la pensée politique si l'Anthropocène exige une repensée de la distinction entre nature et culture et quelles obligations politiques et éthiques découlent de vivre dans un système terrestre dominé par l'humain.
hint: She contended that the concept of the Anthropocene examines what the designation of a new geological epoch defined by human impact on the planet implies for philosophy environmental ethics and political thought whether the Anthropocene demands a rethinking of the distinction between nature and culture and what political and ethical obligations arise from living in a human-dominated earth system.
answers: She contended that the concept of the Anthropocene examines what the designation of a new geological epoch defined by human impact on the planet implies for philosophy environmental ethics and political thought whether the Anthropocene demands a rethinking of the distinction between nature and culture and what political and ethical obligations arise from living in a human-dominated earth system.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de posthumanisme examine les suppositions de l'humanisme classique y compris la centralité du sujet humain rationnel et autonome et soutient que les transformations technologiques biologiques et écologiques nécessitent une reconceptualisation de ce que signifie être humain au-delà du cadre humaniste libéral qui a dominé la pensée occidentale.
hint: He argued that the concept of posthumanism examines the assumptions of classical humanism including the centrality of the autonomous rational human subject and argues that technological biological and ecological transformations require a reconceptualisation of what it means to be human beyond the liberal humanist framework that dominated Western thought.
answers: He argued that the concept of posthumanism examines the assumptions of classical humanism including the centrality of the autonomous rational human subject and argues that technological biological and ecological transformations require a reconceptualisation of what it means to be human beyond the liberal humanist framework that dominated Western thought.

en: Elle a soutenu que le nouveau matérialisme développé par Barad Braidotti et d'autres examine comment la matière et le sens sont intra-activement co-constitués remettant en cause à la fois le constructivisme social qui réduit tout au discours et le réalisme naïf qui ignore le rôle des cadres conceptuels et des questions dans la constitution de ce qui devient observable et connaissable.
hint: She maintained that new materialism as developed by Barad Braidotti and others examines how matter and meaning are intra-actively co-constituted challenging both social constructivism which reduces everything to discourse and naïve realism which ignores the role of conceptual frameworks and questions in constituting what becomes observable and knowable.
answers: She maintained that new materialism as developed by Barad Braidotti and others examines how matter and meaning are intra-actively co-constituted challenging both social constructivism which reduces everything to discourse and naïve realism which ignores the role of conceptual frameworks and questions in constituting what becomes observable and knowable.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de réalisme spéculatif comme mouvement émergent dans la philosophie contemporaine examine comment surmonter ce que Meillassoux appelle le corrélationisme l'idée que la réalité est toujours déjà corrélée avec la pensée et comment la pensée philosophique peut accéder à une réalité qui est en principe indépendante de la pensée et de l'expérience humaines.
hint: He contended that the concept of speculative realism as an emerging movement in contemporary philosophy examines how to overcome what Meillassoux calls correlationism the view that reality is always already correlated with thought and how philosophical thought can gain access to a reality that is in principle independent of human thought and experience.
answers: He contended that the concept of speculative realism as an emerging movement in contemporary philosophy examines how to overcome what Meillassoux calls correlationism the view that reality is always already correlated with thought and how philosophical thought can gain access to a reality that is in principle independent of human thought and experience.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'ontologie orientée-objet développé par Harman soutient que les objets qu'ils soient naturels artificiels grands ou petits ont une réalité qui ne peut pas être épuisée par leurs relations avec d'autres objets ou avec des sujets humains et qu'il y a un aspect retiré de chaque objet qui est à jamais inaccessible aux autres objets et aux humains.
hint: She argued that the concept of object-oriented ontology as developed by Harman holds that objects whether natural artificial large or small have a reality that cannot be exhausted by their relations to other objects or to human subjects and that there is a withdrawn aspect of every object that is forever inaccessible to other objects and humans alike.
answers: She argued that the concept of object-oriented ontology as developed by Harman holds that objects whether natural artificial large or small have a reality that cannot be exhausted by their relations to other objects or to human subjects and that there is a withdrawn aspect of every object that is forever inaccessible to other objects and humans alike.

en: Il a soutenu que l'accélérationnisme comme philosophie politique examine si les contradictions et les crises du capitalisme devraient être accélérées et intensifiées plutôt que réformées ou résistées comme stratégie pour provoquer une rupture permettant une transition au-delà du capitalisme soulevant des questions sur les risques d'une telle stratégie et sa relation avec les mouvements politiques de gauche et de droite.
hint: He maintained that accelerationism as a political philosophy examines whether the contradictions and crises of capitalism should be accelerated and intensified rather than reformed or resisted as a strategy for provoking a rupture that enables a transition beyond capitalism raising questions about the risks of such a strategy and its relationship to left and right political movements.
answers: He maintained that accelerationism as a political philosophy examines whether the contradictions and crises of capitalism should be accelerated and intensified rather than reformed or resisted as a strategy for provoking a rupture that enables a transition beyond capitalism raising questions about the risks of such a strategy and its relationship to left and right political movements.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de xénoféminisme développé par le collectif Laboria Cuboniks soutient que le féminisme devrait embrasser la technologie la raison et l'universalisme plutôt que de se retirer vers le naturel le local et le particulier et que les nouvelles technologies y compris les technologies reproductives la génomique et les produits pharmaceutiques offrent des opportunités féministes pour transformer les conditions qui produisent l'inégalité de genre.
hint: She contended that the concept of xenofeminism as developed by the Laboria Cuboniks collective argues that feminism should embrace technology reason and universalism rather than retreat to the natural the local and the particular and that new technologies including reproductive technologies genomics and pharmaceuticals offer feminist opportunities for transforming the conditions that produce gender inequality.
answers: She contended that the concept of xenofeminism as developed by the Laboria Cuboniks collective argues that feminism should embrace technology reason and universalism rather than retreat to the natural the local and the particular and that new technologies including reproductive technologies genomics and pharmaceuticals offer feminist opportunities for transforming the conditions that produce gender inequality.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de féminisme intersectionnel développé à partir de l'analyse juridique de Crenshaw soutient que les expériences des femmes à l'intersection de multiples systèmes oppressifs tels que la race le genre la classe la sexualité et le handicap ne peuvent pas être comprises par des analyses à axe unique et que la théorie et l'activisme féministes doivent affronter les multiples oppressions simultanées.
hint: He argued that the concept of intersectional feminism as developed from Crenshaw's legal analysis holds that the experiences of women at the intersection of multiple oppressive systems such as race gender class sexuality and disability cannot be understood through single-axis analyses and that feminist theory and activism must grapple with multiple simultaneous oppressions.
answers: He argued that the concept of intersectional feminism as developed from Crenshaw's legal analysis holds that the experiences of women at the intersection of multiple oppressive systems such as race gender class sexuality and disability cannot be understood through single-axis analyses and that feminist theory and activism must grapple with multiple simultaneous oppressions.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de théorie du privilège examine comment les avantages non mérités s'accumulent chez les membres des groupes dominants d'une manière souvent invisible pour ceux qui en bénéficient et que la reconnaissance de son privilège est une première étape vers le démantèlement des systèmes d'oppression plutôt que de simplement gérer les préjugés individuels.
hint: She maintained that the concept of privilege theory examines how unearned advantages accrue to members of dominant groups in ways that are often invisible to those who benefit from them and that recognising one's privilege is a first step toward dismantling systems of oppression rather than merely managing individual biases.
answers: She maintained that the concept of privilege theory examines how unearned advantages accrue to members of dominant groups in ways that are often invisible to those who benefit from them and that recognising one's privilege is a first step toward dismantling systems of oppression rather than merely managing individual biases.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de décolonialité développé par Mignolo Quijano et le groupe modernité-colonialité soutient que la modernité est constitutionnellement enchevêtrée avec la colonialité et que la pensée décoloniale exige un délinkage des suppositions eurocentriques qui structurent les formes dominantes de connaissance de politique et d'être pour ouvrir un espace à des façons de connaître pluriverselles.
hint: He contended that the concept of decoloniality as developed by Mignolo Quijano and the modernity-coloniality group holds that modernity is constitutively entangled with coloniality and that decolonial thought requires delinking from the Eurocentric assumptions that structure dominant forms of knowledge politics and being in order to open space for pluriversal ways of knowing.
answers: He contended that the concept of decoloniality as developed by Mignolo Quijano and the modernity-coloniality group holds that modernity is constitutively entangled with coloniality and that decolonial thought requires delinking from the Eurocentric assumptions that structure dominant forms of knowledge politics and being in order to open space for pluriversal ways of knowing.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de politique de la reconnaissance développé par Taylor et Honneth soutient que les luttes pour la reconnaissance sont centrales à la politique contemporaine que la méconnaissance est une forme de préjudice social et qu'une politique de la différence doit réconcilier le principe universel de dignité égale avec le respect pour les identités particulières des communautés culturelles.
hint: She argued that the concept of recognition politics as developed by Taylor and Honneth holds that struggles for recognition are central to contemporary politics that misrecognition is a form of social harm and that a politics of difference must reconcile the universal principle of equal dignity with respect for the particular identities of cultural communities.
answers: She argued that the concept of recognition politics as developed by Taylor and Honneth holds that struggles for recognition are central to contemporary politics that misrecognition is a form of social harm and that a politics of difference must reconcile the universal principle of equal dignity with respect for the particular identities of cultural communities.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de philosophie de la traduction examine ce qui est perdu ou gagné dans la traduction si la traduction parfaite est possible comment la traduction se rapporte à la compréhension culturelle et si la traduction implique toujours un exercice de pouvoir car les langues dominantes imposent leurs cadres sémantiques aux textes traduits d'autres traditions.
hint: He maintained that the concept of the philosophy of translation examines what is lost or gained in translation whether perfect translation is possible how translation relates to cultural understanding and whether translation always involves an exercise of power as dominant languages impose their semantic frameworks on translated texts from other traditions.
answers: He maintained that the concept of the philosophy of translation examines what is lost or gained in translation whether perfect translation is possible how translation relates to cultural understanding and whether translation always involves an exercise of power as dominant languages impose their semantic frameworks on translated texts from other traditions.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de quiétisme philosophique associé à Wittgenstein soutient que la philosophie ne devrait pas tenter de répondre aux questions métaphysiques mais devrait plutôt les dissoudre en montrant qu'elles découlent de confusions grammaticales et que le but de la philosophie est une représentation perspicace de nos pratiques linguistiques et non une explication théorique.
hint: She contended that the concept of philosophical quietism associated with Wittgenstein holds that philosophy should not attempt to answer metaphysical questions but should instead dissolve them by showing that they arise from grammatical confusions and that the goal of philosophy is a perspicuous representation of our language practices not theoretical explanation.
answers: She contended that the concept of philosophical quietism associated with Wittgenstein holds that philosophy should not attempt to answer metaphysical questions but should instead dissolve them by showing that they arise from grammatical confusions and that the goal of philosophy is a perspicuous representation of our language practices not theoretical explanation.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de vérité pragmatique développé par Peirce soutient que la vérité est ce sur quoi l'enquête convergerait dans le long terme idéal et que l'enquête scientifique comprise comme une communauté auto-correctrice d'enquêteurs approchera asymptotiquement la vérité par le test et la révision continus des hypothèses à l'encontre de l'expérience et des preuves.
hint: He argued that the concept of pragmatic truth as developed by Peirce holds that truth is what inquiry would converge on in the ideal long run and that scientific inquiry understood as a self-correcting community of investigators will asymptotically approach truth through the continuous testing and revision of hypotheses against experience and evidence.
answers: He argued that the concept of pragmatic truth as developed by Peirce holds that truth is what inquiry would converge on in the ideal long run and that scientific inquiry understood as a self-correcting community of investigators will asymptotically approach truth through the continuous testing and revision of hypotheses against experience and evidence.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'externalisme sémantique développé par Putnam et Kripke soutient que les significations de nombreux termes en particulier les termes de genre naturel et les noms propres ne sont pas déterminées par les états mentaux des locuteurs mais par des relations causales avec les choses dans le monde de sorte que la signification n'est pas dans la tête.
hint: She maintained that the concept of semantic externalism as developed by Putnam and Kripke holds that the meanings of many terms particularly natural kind terms and proper names are not determined by speakers' mental states but by causal relations to things in the world so that meaning ain't in the head.
answers: She maintained that the concept of semantic externalism as developed by Putnam and Kripke holds that the meanings of many terms particularly natural kind terms and proper names are not determined by speakers' mental states but by causal relations to things in the world so that meaning ain't in the head.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de propositions comme porteurs de valeur de vérité soulève des questions philosophiques sur ce que sont les propositions si elles sont des objets platoniciens abstraits des états mentaux des types linguistiques ou des entités structurées comment les propositions se rapportent aux phrases et aux énoncés et s'il existe une distinction entre les propositions exprimées par des phrases dans différentes langues.
hint: He contended that the concept of propositions as the bearers of truth value raises philosophical questions about what propositions are whether they are abstract Platonic objects mental states linguistic types or structured entities how propositions relate to sentences and utterances and whether there is a distinction between propositions expressed by sentences in different languages.
answers: He contended that the concept of propositions as the bearers of truth value raises philosophical questions about what propositions are whether they are abstract Platonic objects mental states linguistic types or structured entities how propositions relate to sentences and utterances and whether there is a distinction between propositions expressed by sentences in different languages.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'épistémologie modale examine comment nous avons la connaissance des revendications modales sur ce qui est nécessaire et ce qui est possible si la connaissance modale est a priori ou nécessite un soutien empirique comment la sémantique à deux dimensions de Chalmers et la nécessité a posteriori de Kripke remettent en cause les vues traditionnelles de la relation entre la nécessité et l'a priori.
hint: She argued that the concept of modal epistemology examines how we have knowledge of modal claims about what is necessary and what is possible whether modal knowledge is a priori or requires empirical support how Chalmers's two-dimensional semantics and Kripke's necessity a posteriori challenge traditional views of the relationship between necessity and the a priori.
answers: She argued that the concept of modal epistemology examines how we have knowledge of modal claims about what is necessary and what is possible whether modal knowledge is a priori or requires empirical support how Chalmers's two-dimensional semantics and Kripke's necessity a posteriori challenge traditional views of the relationship between necessity and the a priori.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de fondement développé dans la métaphysique analytique contemporaine désigne une relation d'explication ou de détermination métaphysique entre des faits où certains faits obtiennent en vertu d'autres faits et soulève des questions sur si le fondement est une relation primitive quelles sont ses propriétés formelles et comment le fondement se rapporte à la nécessité à la réduction et à la causalité.
hint: He maintained that the concept of grounding as developed in contemporary analytic metaphysics refers to a relation of metaphysical explanation or determination between facts where some facts obtain in virtue of other facts and raises questions about whether grounding is a primitive relation what its formal properties are and how grounding relates to necessity reduction and causation.
answers: He maintained that the concept of grounding as developed in contemporary analytic metaphysics refers to a relation of metaphysical explanation or determination between facts where some facts obtain in virtue of other facts and raises questions about whether grounding is a primitive relation what its formal properties are and how grounding relates to necessity reduction and causation.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de méréologie comme branche de l'ontologie formelle examine la relation partie-tout quelles sont les conditions de la composition quand plusieurs choses composent une seule chose s'il existe un objet universel composé de tout et si les sommes mereologiques d'objets arbitraires existent ou seulement des objets qui satisfont des conditions supplémentaires d'unité.
hint: She contended that the concept of mereology as a branch of formal ontology examines the part-whole relation what the conditions are for composition when many things compose one thing whether there is a universal object composed of everything and whether mereological sums of arbitrary objects exist or only objects that meet further conditions of unity.
answers: She contended that the concept of mereology as a branch of formal ontology examines the part-whole relation what the conditions are for composition when many things compose one thing whether there is a universal object composed of everything and whether mereological sums of arbitrary objects exist or only objects that meet further conditions of unity.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la persistance à travers le temps examine si les objets persistent en endurant en étant entièrement présents à chaque moment de leur existence ou en perdurant en ayant des parties temporelles différentes à des moments différents et comment chaque vue gère le problème des intrinsèques temporaires où les objets ont des propriétés intrinsèques incompatibles à des moments différents.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of persistence through time examines whether objects persist by enduring being wholly present at each moment throughout their existence or by perduring having different temporal parts at different times and how each view handles the problem of temporary intrinsics where objects have incompatible intrinsic properties at different times.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of persistence through time examines whether objects persist by enduring being wholly present at each moment throughout their existence or by perduring having different temporal parts at different times and how each view handles the problem of temporary intrinsics where objects have incompatible intrinsic properties at different times.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'ontologie personnelle examine quel type de chose est une personne si les personnes sont des objets matériels des continuants psychologiques ou des constructions sociales quelles conditions sont nécessaires et suffisantes pour que quelque chose soit une personne et si la personnalité admet des degrés ou est tout ou rien.
hint: She maintained that the concept of personal ontology examines what kind of thing a person is whether persons are material objects psychological continuants or social constructions what conditions are necessary and sufficient for something to be a person and whether personhood admits of degrees or is all-or-nothing.
answers: She maintained that the concept of personal ontology examines what kind of thing a person is whether persons are material objects psychological continuants or social constructions what conditions are necessary and sufficient for something to be a person and whether personhood admits of degrees or is all-or-nothing.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de fiction et de vérité examine si nous pouvons apprendre des vérités à partir des œuvres fictionnelles comment les personnages fictifs devraient être compris ontologiquement si ils existent comme des objets abstraits ou seulement dans le contexte de l'histoire fictive et comment l'engagement imaginatif avec la fiction se rapporte à la connaissance à la compréhension et à l'éducation morale.
hint: He contended that the concept of fiction and truth examines whether we can learn truths from fictional works how fictional characters should be understood ontologically whether they exist as abstract objects or only within the context of the fictional story and how imaginative engagement with fiction relates to knowledge understanding and moral education.
answers: He contended that the concept of fiction and truth examines whether we can learn truths from fictional works how fictional characters should be understood ontologically whether they exist as abstract objects or only within the context of the fictional story and how imaginative engagement with fiction relates to knowledge understanding and moral education.

en: Elle a soutenu que le paradoxe de la fiction examine pourquoi les lecteurs répondent émotionnellement aux événements et personnages fictifs qu'ils savent ne pas exister si de telles réponses sont de véritables émotions des réponses cognitives ou des simulacres imaginatifs et s'il existe une asymétrie entre les réponses émotionnelles à la fiction et la façon dont les émotions se rapportent à l'action dans la vie réelle.
hint: She argued that the paradox of fiction examines why readers respond emotionally to fictional events and characters they know not to exist whether such responses are genuine emotions cognitive responses or imaginative simulacra and whether there is an asymmetry between emotional responses to fiction and the way emotions relate to action in real life.
answers: She argued that the paradox of fiction examines why readers respond emotionally to fictional events and characters they know not to exist whether such responses are genuine emotions cognitive responses or imaginative simulacra and whether there is an asymmetry between emotional responses to fiction and the way emotions relate to action in real life.

en: Il a soutenu que le concept de beauté tragique examine pourquoi les représentations de la souffrance de la perte et de la destruction dans l'art peuvent être belles et agréables à contempler Aristote l'expliquant par la catharsis Schopenhauer par l'évasion esthétique de la volonté Nietzsche par l'affirmation de la vie et Williams par la reconnaissance de la complexité morale de l'expérience humaine.
hint: He maintained that the concept of tragic beauty examines why representations of suffering loss and destruction in art can be beautiful and pleasurable to contemplate Aristotle explaining this through catharsis Schopenhauer through aesthetic escape from the will Nietzsche through the affirmation of life and Williams through recognition of the moral complexity of human experience.
answers: He maintained that the concept of tragic beauty examines why representations of suffering loss and destruction in art can be beautiful and pleasurable to contemplate Aristotle explaining this through catharsis Schopenhauer through aesthetic escape from the will Nietzsche through the affirmation of life and Williams through recognition of the moral complexity of human experience.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie du grotesque examine les œuvres d'art les images et les expériences qui combinent le beau et l'horrible le familier et l'étranger qui violent les frontières corporelles et catégorielles et soulève des questions sur la valeur esthétique de la transgression la relation entre le grotesque et la comédie et les usages politiques des images grotesques.
hint: She contended that the philosophy of the grotesque examines artworks images and experiences that combine the beautiful and the horrific the familiar and the alien that violate bodily and categorical boundaries and raises questions about the aesthetic value of transgression the relationship between the grotesque and comedy and the political uses of grotesque imagery.
answers: She contended that the philosophy of the grotesque examines artworks images and experiences that combine the beautiful and the horrific the familiar and the alien that violate bodily and categorical boundaries and raises questions about the aesthetic value of transgression the relationship between the grotesque and comedy and the political uses of grotesque imagery.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du genre examine comment les conventions de genre dans la littérature le cinéma et la musique structurent les attentes du public façonnent les cadres interprétatifs contraignent la créativité artistique et si les catégories de genre sont des genres naturels découverts par les critiques ou des constructions sociales produites par le marché les attentes du public et le discours critique.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of genre examines how genre conventions in literature film and music structure audience expectations shape interpretive frameworks constrain artistic creativity and whether genre categories are natural kinds discovered by critics or social constructions produced by the market audience expectations and critical discourse.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of genre examines how genre conventions in literature film and music structure audience expectations shape interpretive frameworks constrain artistic creativity and whether genre categories are natural kinds discovered by critics or social constructions produced by the market audience expectations and critical discourse.

en: Elle a soutenu que la philosophie de la poésie épique et narrative examine comment les poèmes épiques tels que l'Iliade l'Odyssée l'Énéide et le Paradis Perdu construisent des cosmologies de valeur créent des communautés de lecteurs et façonnent la mémoire culturelle et l'identité politique et ce qui fait de la poésie narrative un mode de compréhension distinct avec des capacités uniques pour illuminer l'existence humaine.
hint: She maintained that the philosophy of epic and narrative poetry examines how epic poems such as the Iliad Odyssey Aeneid and Paradise Lost construct cosmologies of value create communities of readers and shape cultural memory and political identity and what makes narrative poetry a distinct mode of understanding with unique capacities for illuminating human existence.
answers: She maintained that the philosophy of epic and narrative poetry examines how epic poems such as the Iliad Odyssey Aeneid and Paradise Lost construct cosmologies of value create communities of readers and shape cultural memory and political identity and what makes narrative poetry a distinct mode of understanding with unique capacities for illuminating human existence.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la tragédie développée d'Aristote à travers Hegel jusqu'aux esthéticiens contemporains examine comment la tragédie comme forme d'art représente des renversements sérieux de fortune et de la souffrance d'une manière qui illumine les caractéristiques universelles de l'existence humaine et soulève des questions sur le destin la nécessité et la contingence qui gouvernent la vie humaine.
hint: He contended that the philosophy of tragedy as developed from Aristotle through Hegel to contemporary aestheticians examines how tragedy as an art form represents serious reversals of fortune and suffering in a way that illuminates universal features of human existence and raises questions about the fate necessity and contingency that govern human life.
answers: He contended that the philosophy of tragedy as developed from Aristotle through Hegel to contemporary aestheticians examines how tragedy as an art form represents serious reversals of fortune and suffering in a way that illuminates universal features of human existence and raises questions about the fate necessity and contingency that govern human life.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept de littérature comparée examine la relation entre la littérature et la culture nationale si la littérature peut transcender les frontières culturelles quelles sont les implications de la littérature mondiale comme Goethe la concevait pour comprendre la relation entre l'universel et le particulier dans la valeur littéraire et comment la traduction permet ou limite la compréhension littéraire interculturelle.
hint: She argued that the concept of comparative literature examines the relationship between literature and national culture whether literature can transcend cultural boundaries what the implications of world literature as Goethe conceived it are for understanding the relationship between the universal and the particular in literary value and how translation enables or limits cross-cultural literary understanding.
answers: She argued that the concept of comparative literature examines the relationship between literature and national culture whether literature can transcend cultural boundaries what the implications of world literature as Goethe conceived it are for understanding the relationship between the universal and the particular in literary value and how translation enables or limits cross-cultural literary understanding.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie de la lecture examine ce qui se passe quand nous lisons si la lecture est une réception passive des messages auctoriaux ou une co-création active de sens comment différents modes de lecture tels que la lecture attentive la lecture à distance et la lecture de surface construisent différemment l'œuvre littéraire et quelles sont les dimensions cognitives et affectives de la lecture littéraire.
hint: He maintained that the philosophy of reading examines what happens when we read whether reading is a passive reception of authorial messages or an active co-creation of meaning how different modes of reading such as close reading distant reading and surface reading differently construct the literary work and what the cognitive and affective dimensions of literary reading are.
answers: He maintained that the philosophy of reading examines what happens when we read whether reading is a passive reception of authorial messages or an active co-creation of meaning how different modes of reading such as close reading distant reading and surface reading differently construct the literary work and what the cognitive and affective dimensions of literary reading are.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept d'humanisme littéraire examine comment la lecture de la littérature contribue à l'épanouissement humain à la cultivation de l'empathie au développement de l'imagination morale et à la formation de l'identité civique et si ces valeurs humanistes peuvent survivre dans le contexte de la culture numérique et de la surcharge d'information.
hint: She contended that the concept of literary humanism examines how reading literature contributes to human flourishing the cultivation of empathy the development of moral imagination and the formation of civic identity and whether these humanistic values can survive in the context of digital culture and information overload.
answers: She contended that the concept of literary humanism examines how reading literature contributes to human flourishing the cultivation of empathy the development of moral imagination and the formation of civic identity and whether these humanistic values can survive in the context of digital culture and information overload.

en: Il a soutenu que la philosophie du poème lyrique examine ce qui est distinctif de la poésie lyrique comme mode d'expression comment la voix à la première personne dans la poésie lyrique diffère de l'identité auctoriale biographique si la poésie lyrique crée ou exprime des émotions et si le contenu philosophique des poèmes lyriques est important différent du contenu philosophique de la prose discursive.
hint: He argued that the philosophy of the lyric poem examines what is distinctive about lyric poetry as a mode of expression how the first-person voice in lyric poetry differs from biographical authorial identity whether lyric poetry creates or expresses emotions and whether the philosophical content of lyric poems is importantly different from the philosophical content of discursive prose.
answers: He argued that the philosophy of the lyric poem examines what is distinctive about lyric poetry as a mode of expression how the first-person voice in lyric poetry differs from biographical authorial identity whether lyric poetry creates or expresses emotions and whether the philosophical content of lyric poems is importantly different from the philosophical content of discursive prose.

en: Elle a soutenu que le concept du dilemme d'Euthyphron soulève la question de savoir si les actions sont bonnes parce que Dieu les commande ou si Dieu commande les actions parce qu'elles sont indépendamment bonnes et que ce dilemme remet en cause les théories éthiques du commandement divin et soulève des questions sur la nature de la bonté et sa relation avec l'autorité religieuse.
hint: She maintained that the concept of the Euthyphro dilemma raises the question of whether actions are good because God commands them or whether God commands actions because they are independently good and that this dilemma challenges divine command theories of ethics and raises questions about the nature of goodness and its relationship to religious authority.
answers: She maintained that the concept of the Euthyphro dilemma raises the question of whether actions are good because God commands them or whether God commands actions because they are independently good and that this dilemma challenges divine command theories of ethics and raises questions about the nature of goodness and its relationship to religious authority.

en: Il a soutenu que l'argument ontologique pour l'existence de Dieu dans la version d'Anselme soutient que Dieu par définition est le plus grand être concevable qu'un être qui existe dans la réalité est plus grand que celui qui existe seulement dans l'entendement et donc Dieu doit exister dans la réalité les discussions contemporaines examinant si cet argument est seulement un tour logique ou révèle quelque chose sur la nature de Dieu.
hint: He contended that the ontological argument for the existence of God in the version of Anselm holds that God by definition is the greatest conceivable being that a being that exists in reality is greater than one that exists only in the understanding and therefore God must exist in reality with contemporary discussions examining whether this argument is merely a logical trick or reveals something about the nature of God.
answers: He contended that the ontological argument for the existence of God in the version of Anselm holds that God by definition is the greatest conceivable being that a being that exists in reality is greater than one that exists only in the understanding and therefore God must exist in reality with contemporary discussions examining whether this argument is merely a logical trick or reveals something about the nature of God.

en: Elle a soutenu que l'argument cosmologique pour l'existence de Dieu dans ses diverses formes soutient que l'existence de l'univers nécessite une cause ou explication qui ne peut elle-même pas nécessiter d'explication et que la meilleure explication est une cause nécessairement existante et non causée qui est Dieu des débats portant sur si l'univers a besoin d'une cause externe et si la régression infinie est impossible.
hint: She argued that the cosmological argument for the existence of God in its various forms holds that the existence of the universe requires a cause or explanation that cannot itself require explanation and that the best explanation is a necessarily existing uncaused cause which is God with debates about whether the universe needs an external cause and whether infinite regress is impossible.
